193448.description:
Former national swimmer Seo Han-seong, praised as a hero of the Republic of Korea. After retirement, he lived a life that no one would envy, living with his cute younger lover Lee Joo-Ho. However, Han-Seong had a worry that no one knew about. It's been a month since he and Joo-Ho haven't had sex! If it were normal, he would have been busy making love all day, but Han-Seong's heart is just upset because his lover's skinship keeps decreasing...

"I'm a hero of the Republic of Korea and Lee Joo-Ho's first love? I can't back down like this."

In order to break this one-sided(?) boredom, something 'new' is needed!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

193449.description:
A nobleman's child who fell from grace due to an unjust accusation, Sa-Ran. While living a life of humiliation as the sex slave of a close friend he trusted, a boy he took in as a child, Eun-Ho, enters the household as a new servant, and a strange tension begins to flow in the household...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

title.native: ギャルのやりらふぃーにっき

193451.description: Originally serialized under the title Jikan wo Ayatsuri Muhkyo Tane Zuke: Shojo kara Ninshin made Mugen Loop (時間をあやつり無許可種付け -処女から妊娠まで無限ループ).
synonyms: Jikan wo Ayatsuri Muhkyo Tane Zuke: Shojo kara Ninshin made Mugen Loop
時間をあやつり無許可種付け -処女から妊娠まで無限ループ

title.native: ハメられインフィニティ

193453.description:
Sol-Bi, who was asked to look after the house while her mother went on a trip to Europe, comes down to her parents' house. While watering the garden, she starts talking to Hee-Yeon, a divorced woman who lives next door, and Sol-Bi feels a thrill towards the affectionate Hee-Yeon. From that day on, the two become closer, and Sol-Bi's feelings for Hee-Yeon grow with each passing day. One day, the two go to an amusement park together with tickets that Hee-Yeon's daughter Ji-Min got. While enjoying a date while riding the rides, snacking, and laughing, when the first snow falls, Sol-Bi confesses to Hee-Yeon that she wants to be her lover by kissing her...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

193454.description:
"Teacher, if I do well on that essay test, let me touch your breasts."

On the first snowy winter of the new year, Joo Ji-Soo, a delinquent repeat student, gets rejected from all the universities he applied to. She was excited about going to a lesbian bar and having fun with big-breasted girls as soon as she finished his entrance exams, but she has no choice but to return home because of his overbearing mother. And then she meets a new private tutor that his mother has hired. As soon as she sees the pretty tutor with big breasts, Ji-Soo falls in love at first sight, and she expresses her feelings in her own way by whining and embarrassing the teacher...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).
synonyms: Are you just going to study?

193455.description:
Seo-Jin, who is obsessed with men but is constantly wooed by women, goes to see a famous shaman with her best friend Yeon-Hee. The shaman tells her that Seo-Jin does not have men's clothing but is popular with the same sex, while Yeon-Hee has a peach blossom arrow and is popular with the opposite sex, but is jealous and envied by the same sex. After confirming their opposing fates, the shaman gives them an amulet that will alleviate their luck. She also prophesies that this amulet will change their fates. Seo-Jin is half-believing the shaman's words and forgets about the amulet, throwing it in a corner of the house. However, Yeon-Hee thoroughly believes in the amulet and always carries it with her, trying to prove its effectiveness to Seo-Jin...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울)

193456.description:
Na-Rin prepared an event to spend her birthday with her boyfriend. However, her boyfriend broke up with her on the same day and Na-Rin was left alone at the hotel she had booked. Na-Rin, who did not want to be alone on her birthday, looked through SNS to find someone to meet and then came across her childhood friend Han-Gyeol, who she had lost contact with after confessing to her. Wanting to meet again after a long time, Na-Rin impulsively contacts Han-Gyeol…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

193457.description:
A year ago, on the first snowy day, Hye-In sees her close older sister Jin-Young with a strange woman in her studio apartment, and since then, she has hated snowy days. She realizes her feelings for her older sister belatedly, but she realizes that she cannot be a 'girlfriend' rather than a 'close younger sister', and decides to take a leave of absence from school to avoid Jin-Young. After a party, she wakes up drunk and finds herself in her room. Jin-Young, who has been supporting her, is nagging her like an older sister again. Hye-In, who is annoyed by the atmosphere that always flows like this, tries to do what suits her best in this space late at night.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

193458.description:
Ecologist Nang Se-Hyeon discovers traces of poachers while conducting a bird watching in a deep mountain that she has been doing every year since late autumn. She expresses her concerns and suddenly encounters Kang Ji-Ah. Se-Hyeon mistakes Ji-Ah for a poacher and attacks her with pepper spray, but Ji-Ah claims that she is an official hunter who has received permission from the mountain owner to hunt harmful birds. However, he loses her pouch containing her permit and contact information after rolling down the mountain path, so there is no way to confirm her identity. Se-Hyeon becomes anxious, suspecting Ji-Ah’s true identity. Since the mountain is far from a base station, cell phones do not work well, and it takes a whole day to get to a house, she cannot send Ji-Ah back immediately. In the end, Se-Hyeon decides to stay with Ji-Ah until she recovers while still being suspicious. Ji-Ah follows Se-Hyeon around as she continues to observe birds, and begins to show curiosity about her work.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).
synonyms: First snow with the mountain lord

193459.description:
Soon-I, the daughter of the Kim family in Doldamgeori, is very concerned about her older sister who sells medicinal herbs at the market. There are many rumors about her sister selling medicinal herbs behind the cloth, but Soon-I does not believe them. She takes care of all the errands for medicinal herbs in the neighborhood and goes to see her older sister every day, and eventually she even dreams about her sister. Then one day, she finds her older sister taking a bath in a hot spring in the forest while it is snowing heavily, and she is captivated by her older sister's gentle smile and enters the bath...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

193460.description:
A shota incubus trying to become a fully fledged sex demon fails his first solo hunting attempt, and instead gets thoroughly cum-squeezed by older women.

(Source: DLsite.com)
synonyms: MILK -A story About An Incubus Being Fondled By Two Onee-sans-
MILK ~Shota Incubus Fondled By Big Ladies~

title.native: MILK －ショタ淫魔がお姉さんたちに挟まれる話－
title.romaji: MILK: Shota Inma ga Onee-san-tachi ni Hasamareru Banashi

title.native: 熟母相姦 四十路の戱れ

synonyms: Tsukumo Nemuru Shizume: Meiji Suushichinen Hen
Tsukumo Nemuru Shizume: Volume of the 17th Year of Meiji
九十九夜伏妖谭-明治十七年篇

title.native: 九十九眠るしずめ 明治十七年編

193466.description:
When quiet, offbeat Takane rescued her lively classmate Arashi from a boy creeping on her, she fully intended to keep to herself. Time after time, Arashi offered to do something in return as thanks, but Takane refused at every turn…Yet little by little, she grew to enjoy having that ray of sunshine in her life. Now, they spend every day together as girlfriends—and Takane can never get enough of the adorable, flustered look on Arashi’s face when she flirts back with her!

(Source: Yen Press)

193473.description:
One day, Yamato Satsuki saw the jagged teeth behind Aisu Kiraragi's mask. As he approached her, those teeth marked the beginning of a sharp and prickly romantic comedy.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: 君の「ギザ歯」が見てみたい。

193474.description:
He was reincarnated as a barbarian tribe with a low level of civilization! A story of rising to power, in which he becomes the chief of a barbarian tribe that lost a war under the control of a powerful empire, and aims to defeat the empire!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 蛮族転生！ 負け戦から始まる異世界征服
title.romaji: Banzoku Tensei! Makeikusa kara Hajimaru Isekai Seifuku

193475.description:
Choi Ah-Hyun, a food columnist with a tongue that savors people's hearts, fell in love with Yu-Dan, who has a sweet taste, but it turns out that he is a chef who went out of business due to his bad reputation... Will she be able to win his heart?

"How can a person have such a scent? How nice it would be if I could taste it just once more."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

synonyms: My Brother's Friend Can't Be This Big!

title.native: 동생 친구가 이렇게 클 리 없어!
title.romaji: Dongsaeng Chinguga Ireoke Keul Ri Eopseo!

193477.description:
Seo-Ah is dragged on a weekend mountain hike by her boss. However, she gets lost alone in the mountain, and as it gets darker and darker, a strange black mansion and beautiful twin brothers appear before her eyes as she trembles in fear...

"Hello. Are you lost?"

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Bomtoon and Lezhin's Dulbodaneun Sen Danpyeonseon (둘보다는 셋 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [둘보다는 셋 단편선] 앳 미드나잇 인 더 캐슬
[Dulbodaneun Sen Danpyeonseon] At Midnight in the Castle
[Three Rather Than Two Anthology] At Midnight in the Castle

193478.description:
Actor Jung Woo-Jin kills his co-star by firing a gun loaded with live bullets instead of a prop while filming a movie. Woo-Jin, who was only acting according to the script, appeals his innocence, but no one believes him. He then encounters Seo Ju-Yeon, who introduces herself as his sponsor, and his bodyguard Kwon Seung-Hyun...

"Honestly, I feel like I'm going to faint just thinking about that time... when the bullet went through my heart."

Could this crazy person have done everything...?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Bomtoon and Lezhin's Dulbodaneun Sen Danpyeonseon (둘보다는 셋 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Three Rather Than Two Anthology] Act Out

193479.description:
When monsters show up, espers rise as heroes. But to Do-Yeong, they're nothing but glorified weapons. However, when Do-Yeong is dragged into the United Esper-Guide Force Command, he is declared the perfect guide for the two most powerful espers alive: brothers Kang-Joon and Yi-Joon. Thrust into a love triangle shaped by power and survival, Do-Yeong has to choose who and what he's willing to endure.

(Source: Tappytoon)

193480.description:
A blinding flash of light, and his village was gone. Lowe vows to reach the floating Island of the Gods, but first, he must venture into a world ruled by a ranking system and claw his way to the top. Trained by the world’s strongest knight, he embarks on a quest to become the top ranker, battling fearsome beasts and ruthless rivals to uncover the truth and save his loved ones.

(Source: WEBTOON)

193481.description:
The main character, Hee-Seo, works at the robot pet company 'Dogpet'. Hee-Seo, who has been interested in animal rights for several years, begins to doubt the company's ethics. At that time, she witnesses illegal dumping of trash in an alley...

(Source: Naver, translated)

193482.description:
Summer, who grew up in a harmonious family, often took care of Soo-Wan, the boy living upstairs who heard the sound of his wife fighting every night. When she started working part-time at an amusement park, she gave Soo-Wan a ticket when he said he wanted to go to the amusement park with his mother. After a while, Soo-Wan and the woman came to the amusement park and were happy to see them. However, she was flustered by the woman's unexpected behavior...

(Source: Naver, translated)

193483.description:
"I'll turn your school into a paradise!"

Chia transfers to Hanamori Academy, a prestigious school with a very strict culture. The rigid school rules make everyone feel suffocated. Fortunately, Chia is a "beautiful revolutionary" who has come to save Hanamori Academy! She transfers to problematic schools and has a mission to make everyone happy by starting a "fun revolution". Together with her partner, a teddy bear named "Funny-chan", she steadily reforms the school by changing the uniforms to cute ones and making the lunches buffet-style. However, she ends up angering the scary principal...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: ちあふるワンダーランド

193484.description:
I'm Koeda Torame, a second year junior high school student. I have a secret. I may look like a beautiful young lady, but I'm actually the daughter of XX! But even a young lady wants to live a "normal" junior high school life! With that in mind, I transferred schools! But, two bodyguards came along with me...! What will happen to my school life?

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.native: オレのお嬢に手を出すな！
title.romaji: Ore no Oujo ni Te wo Dasu na!

193485.description:
Serika has a childhood friend named Sora. Ever since they were little, he was cute and a crybaby, Serika has always protected the angelic Sora. But lately, Serika has started to dislike the fact that everyone thinks Sora is an angel. And Sora's "sly face" that only she knows keeps making her heart flutter!?

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

title.romaji: Tenshi na Kimi no Zurui Kao

193486.description:
Kaito, who Himeka has a secret crush on, loves the sea, unlike Himeka who can't swim! One day, Himeka was watching Kaito swimming and playing as usual when he drowned! Himeka was somehow able to save Kaito with the help of a magic spell that turns her into a mermaid after the sea witch Myuu suddenly appeared. However, she becomes a mermaid every time she gets wet! Will Himeka be able to return to her original body? What will become of her love with Kaito?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 敗惨姫騎士IFストーリー 王子と純愛エッチ短
title.romaji: Haizan Himekishi IF Story: Ouji to Junai Ecchi Tan

193488.description:
When a boy called her out and confessed his love to her, it turned out to be a prank... Sayo was upset that she had been tricked, and vowed to become cute and get back at him. When she entered high school, Gai Suzumiya started talking to her, and for some reason he knew about her past. As they spent time together she started to become interested in him...!

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

193489.description:
A primary school student transforms into a high school girl with a mysterious drug!?

Nana, a fifth grader, can transform into a beautiful high school girl by taking a drug that turns her into an adult! She comes up with a plan to get back at her mean tutor Youichi, but...? A high-tension romantic comedy about the naive and foolish Nana and the tsundere, bespectacled Youichi who can't be honest with himself.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: オトナみたいに恋してる!

193490.description:
Airi Katagiri, is a high school girl who cannot ignore people in trouble. One day while on her way to school, a magic circle appears under Airi's feet and she is sent to the Demon World. In the Demon World, demons are performing a ritual to revive the Demon Lord, which summons Airi. Seeing her, the demons think that they have failed to revive the Demon Lord, but it turns out that Airi has the power of the Demon Lord. In order to find a clue to return to her original world, she decides to become the Demon Lord.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: ただのJK、異世界で魔王になる
title.romaji: Tada no JK, Isekai de Maou ni Naru

193491.description:
Magical Fromage is an online shop that sells magical items that can grant any wish. The shop's owner, a witch named Maju, receives a variety of orders all the time. But it seems that Maju is no ordinary witch... In addition, Maju's troublesome friends continue to appear!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: とろけるまじかるフロマージュ

synonyms: Hakiri-san Wants to be Your Very Own Grim Reaper

title.native: 葉木莉さんは君だけの死神になりたい
title.romaji: Hakiri-san wa Kimi Dake no Shinigami ni Narita

193495.description:
Seo-Won, who has been a beta all his life, suddenly experiences a heat cycle when he manifests as an enthusiastic omega one day. Because of this, he ends up spending a night with her stepbrother's son, Yo-Han... Unlike Seo-Won, who tries to pretend the 'accident' never happened, Yo-Han gradually reveals his hidden obsession.

"I like you, Uncle."

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

193496.description:
The shy Shinobu is in love with the prince of the school. They can't even talk to each other because her super-siscon brother Akihira keeps interfering! A love-triangle comedy full of heart-pounding suspense and sweet kisses!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes three extra chapters.

193497.description: Note: Published in WEB Ban COMIC Gekiyaba! Vol. 144

193498.description:
Shirasaki Hina dreams of a wonderful romance with her ideal boyfriend. A 3D cell phone app that whispers sweet words to her just like a boyfriend would, was developed based on Hina's fantasies. Even though Hina has a crush on Akaishi-senpai, she is being pushed around by the cell phone boyfriend born from her delusions!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes three extra chapters.

193499.description:
Three handsome brothers suddenly appear in front of Suzu. Although they don't look alike, they are triplets and are super cool! But their true identities are XXX!? They say they have come to make Suzu happy, but a series of mishaps await them.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 鈴と3つごのボーイフレンド

193500.description:
On the brink of a major update, the lead developer of a full-sensory VR game uncovers a fatal bug and is pulled into the world he built. Trapped inside a stage that responds to touch, breath, and desire, he’s offered a single way out: complete a cryptic quest from an unseen presence. As the game blurs sensation and control, survival means surrendering to rules far more intimate than code.

(Source: Lezhin US)

193501.description:
The effortlessly popular Koimomo is known as "Love Devil Momo." One day, she meets Kiki, a real devil! Kiki saves her life, but in exchange, she is forced to make a contract with him. Kiki tells her to make a boy fall in love with her and steal his heart. Koimomo is reluctant, but she is told that she will be set free if she can steal one of the rarest hearts, so she approaches Kanade, the owner of a rare heart.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: スタート オーバー アゲイン

193503.description:
A high school girl named Kotori Tenma lives alone after losing her parents at a young age. Although she is poor, she lives a cheerful and energetic life. One day, she finds a job posting for a maid part-time job with a very high hourly wage! She immediately visits the mansion, but it turns out to be a mafia hideout! Furthermore, due to a series of events, Kotori becomes the target of an enemy mafia member, and she is forced to accept an offer from the mansion's owner, Narumi Hino.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

193504.description:
Hikari transfers to a new school and becomes the manager of her beloved basketball club. Yamato, the ace who shoots beautifully, is unsociable. But he occasionally shows kindness, and Hikari is increasingly drawn to him. Meanwhile, Hikari's childhood friend and Yamato's best friend, Riku, has had a crush on Hikari ever since they were children. And Yamato...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title.native: 絶対俺のこと好きじゃん？
title.romaji: Zettai Ore no Koto Suki jan?

193506.description:
A middle-aged man with a comical appearance is brought to the Nogata Police Station for a minor assault. The police dismiss him as a mere drunk, but during the interrogation, the man predicts that “there will be an explosion in Akihabara at 10:00 a.m.” Soon after, an abandoned building in Akihabara explodes. Is it possible that this man is the one who set the bomb? The man then tells the police, “There are three bombs. The next one will explode in one hour.” Can the police stop the subsequent explosions?

(Source: Kodansha)

193507.description:
I love you no matter whether you are on stage, on the big screen, or when you are right beside me! When you sparkle so bright I want to hug tight…! Idols, models, and actresses all have moments when they just want to be ordinary girls. Please accept them as they are!

This is an anthology of “celebrity x yuri” stories, featuring an awesome team of manga artists!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Private Life Is Left To Them Talent x Yuri Anthology

title.native: プライベートは本人たちに任せております。芸能人×百合アンソロジー
title.romaji: Private wa Honnintachi ni Makasete Orimasu. Geinoujin x Yuri Anthology

193508.description:
This is a story about the daily life of a patient suffering from depression. In this story, Zhizhi the healing bear will gradually help Yuyu the red panda walk out of the shadows.

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: The Healing Bear and the Red Panda
title.romaji: Zhi Yu Xiong Yu Yi Yu Mao

193509.description:
I've loved you since the day I was born.

A romantic comedy unfolds between an overly passionate prince and a reborn idiot who insists he's straight. Even though he likes girls, he's been reborn as Gill, the 'heroine' of a romance manga. He tries to keep his distance from the protagonist, Darion, but Darion has been pursuing him since they were born—following Gill's route. He attempts to flirt with some girls in front of Darion, but Darion takes him to an empty classroom and kisses him. "I won't let you go until the day I die," he says, smiling...

Is Gill going to be fucked by Darion?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Reborn as the Heroine and It's Freaking Me Out
title.native: おれがヒロインすぎてこわい

193510.description:
"I'm a Natural-Born Dirty-Minded Masterpiece!"

An ordinary guy with an over-the-top talent for sex is studying how to be lovable outside the bedroom to maintain a long-lasting relationship! Masato Bonda, the epitome of "ordinary," believes he has no talents beyond sex, yet feels overwhelmingly adored by his high-spec, handsome boyfriend, Daiki. He's convinced it's all thanks to his "charm down there," and their nights are filled with passionate encounters. However, Bonda begins to worry that as their sex drive fades with age, Daiki might leave him. Determined to find talents beyond sex, Bonda works hard to discover new ways to keep their love alive. But instead of improving in other areas, he finds himself falling even deeper into the traps of passion...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Sex Is My Only True Talent
title.native: 俺にはエロ以外の才能がない
title.romaji: Ore niwa Ero Igai no Sainou ga Nai

193511.description:
After 16 years of unrequited feelings, King Luna finds himself entangled in a whirlwind of love and family with his crush, Captain of the Knights, Jake. It all begins with an innocent request from Luna's younger brother: 'I want a Mama and Papa!' As they navigate their new roles in this makeshift family, including a fake marriage, the bond between Luna and Jake grows stronger. However, the challenges of parenthood weigh heavily on Luna, leaving him feeling worthless. When he finally reveals his vulnerabilities to Jake, he finds solace in Jake's strong, gentle embrace. But as Jake's kindness continues to melt Luna's defenses, will he be able to keep his lingering feelings at bay?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 国王陛下はママになりたい
title.romaji: Kokuou Heika wa Mama ni Naritai

193512.description:
Song Jeong-Won is an active member of the BDSM community, offering guidance and advice to newcomers. One day, he comes across a distressing post from Kang Hoseob, a beginner who has fallen into the hands of an abusive dom and is seeking help. Realizing that Hoseob lacks even the most basic knowledge of BDSM, Jeong-Won steps in—not just to rescue him but to personally guide him as his temporary dom.

"Master, I'll be good...I promise."

Jeong-Won takes on the challenge, but can he truly teach Hoseob the foundations of trust, consent, and desire before it's too late?

(Source: Lezhin US)

193513.description:
Verden, a first-tier mage with a genius intellect but no innate magical talent, is condemned to life as a secret test subject after a devastating betrayal at the Magic Tower. Driven by a thirst for revenge and survival, he develops the "Theory of Celestial Reversal," unlocking limitless potential. But with the tower’s dark forces still looming and mysterious organizations entwining with his fate, will Verden’s quest for vengeance and self-discovery lead to triumph, or will he be shackled once more by inescapable limitations?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: 突破極限的天才魔法師

193514.description:
Alicia Sirius Rayne, a timid, stuttering spinster betrothed to the rumored "Grand Duchess Serial Killer," falls into Hell after opening a mysterious artifact. Now, she must adapt to survive. Years later, she has become a fierce warrior. But as she sets out to conquer all of Hell -- she wakes up in the past. Armed with a second chance at life and a new goal, Alicia must actively pursue the feared Grand Duke Reikart Tessen to secure her destiny. Can this fierce warrior from Hell win the heart of the man who has "killed" six grand duchesses?!

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Grand Duke's Bride Is a Hellborn Warrior

title.english: The Grand Duke’s Bride is a Warrior from Hell

193515.description:
Alfonso is a Sub who boasts the school's top grades and abilities however, powers of a Dom are ineffective to him. That is until he meets Asuka, a new student and a Dom. Asuka challenges Alfonso to a duel with the condition that if he wins, Alfonso will become his partner. Alfonso accepts with the intention of beating the cocky junior, but his body suddenly reacts to Asuka's unexpected words...!

(Source: Libre, translated)

Notes:
- During serialization, Chapters 1 to 5 were split into two parts, while Chapter 6 was split into three parts. These were all combined in the volume release.
- Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: The lonely Sub will find love with only one Dom

title.native: 孤高のSubは恋を知らない
title.romaji: Kokou no Sub wa Koi wo Shiranai

193516.description:
Manami, a university student, approaches Kouichirou, a science graduate student as well as his older sister's arranged marriage candidate, to gauge his character for her shy sister. But, his impression is absolutely terrible! However, on a rainy day, they unexpectedly meet again...!

(Source: Kobunsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
193516.hashtag: #ラブ・チェイン・ラブ・ジーン

title.native: ラブ・チェイン・ラブ・ジーン
トライ・アンド・エラー・アンド
ポメ先輩はバレたくない

193519.description:
Qiao Mu died a tragic death, but she was given a new beginning through rebirth. She appears like a little kid on the outside, but she actually possesses incredible cultivation ability and intellect. In this life, she will take revenge on the culprits who had left her ruined and orphaned! But in this lifetime, she also runs into a silly but cute Crown Prince. Not only does he keep on shamelessly bringing her equipment for beating up the baddies with, but he even wants her to become his consort? Wait, something seems to have gone wrong!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: My Crown Prince Consort Is a Firecracker

title.romaji: Wo Jia Taizifei Chao Xiong Di

193520.description:
A soul from a different world was summoned to the world of cultivation. The female immortal gave her the inheritance of 10,000 years, so that she embarked on the cultivation unexpectedly! Hold on, how could there be such a good thing? The female fairy also gave her a task to save the “evil Lord”... How could she make up for the guilt from her previous life? How would she do when facing the love debts that she couldn’t avoid nor pay back?

(Source: Webnovel)

193521.description:
Kang Ha-Na, a former girl group trainee, gives up everything and has a baby due to an unexpected pregnancy. She leaves the baby in a baby box until she can save up for a house deposit, but she finds out that a famous actor and director couple have adopted the baby, and she goes to work as their babysitter to get the baby back. However, the wife, Angela, is transfusing the baby's blood. Like a vampire. Kang Ha-Na decides to kill her.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.

193522.description:
When defective omega and skilled mercenary Erad Nox is hired to find a runaway alpha mage and bring him back to the Tower of Mages, he thinks it'll be the easiest job he's ever done in his life. Little did he expect that upon meeting Lucian, the mage in question, he'd suddenly enter his heat cycle - something that hasn't happened in the past 11 years. Intrigued by this strange phenomenon, Lucian asks him to stay and become his research subject. As they spend time together, Nox finds himself drawn to Lucian's compassion and bashful kindness, while Lucian begins to fall in love with Nox's fearless strength and integrity.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

193523.description:
What’s a girl to do when a problematic fave ends up as the catch of the day? After a long hospitalization in her past life, Yuri is thrilled to wake up on a mysterious island feeling fit and healthy. She even gets a reprieve from lonely island life in the form of a handsome man fished out of the ocean! But when she discovers the charming prince is destined to become the tyrannical male lead from one of her favorite romance novels, it’s up to Yuri to keep him from going bad… no matter what it takes!

(Source: Tappytoon)

193524.description:
Ever since her life was saved by a kind, golden-haired mage, Piachel has dreamed of being reunited with him. So when she’s given an opportunity to become a “Sharing,” a partner who shares their power with a mage through intimate relationships, Piachel takes the chance in the hopes of finding him. But will she be able to find her savior among the mysterious mages of the Magic Tower? And how much does she really know about the man she wishes to devote her body and soul to?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: รักร้อนซ่อนมนตรา

193525.description:
Reo and Michiru are best friends who were born on the same day, at the same time, and in the same hospital. Reo is a kind-hearted all-around athlete, while Michiru is a beautiful nerdy girl. These two polar opposites get along very well. But... that's not the only thing that makes them special. In fact, when they put their hands together, they can use psychic powers! This is a secret that no one knows, an SxS (super secret) that only the two of them know. But their classmate Takarada finds out about this secret! And what is Takarada's true identity...?!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

193526.description:
Tsumugi is a boy who doesn't attend classes and spends his time engrossed in reading books in the Japanese reference room. He was once known as a "genius junior high school novelist", but now he has stopped writing novels. He meets Kotoha, a bright and innocent girl who is not good at Japanese. His encounter with her changes Tsumugi.

A sparkling coming-of-age story set in a seaside town in Niigata!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ぼくが紡ぐ君のコトノハ
title.romaji: Boku ga Tsumugu Kimi no Kotonoha

193527.description:
A woman's emergence.

(Source: Fakku)

Note: Published in WEEKLY Kairakuten 2023 No.02

title.native: あなただけの彼女じゃないから
title.romaji: Anata dake no Kanojo Janai kara

193529.description:
Shiragiku Amano's dream is to become an "angel in white" like her mother. She can't just leave injured or bad people alone! One day, she gets caught up in a fight with the delinquent group BLAX, and is mistaken for a member of BLAX by the opposing group. In the midst of all this, she pretends to be the girlfriend of BLAX member Kuroya in order to be protected from their enemies. In addition to Kuroya, BLAX also has the womanizer Akao and the slightly mysterious Aonami.

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

193530.description:
Yume, who loves food and is full of energy, meets a real prince named Alto! He is friendly and kind, and transfers to Yume's school. However, due to an unexpected turn of events, Alto ends up spending all of his money on other people, and becomes the "Poor Prince"...!?

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

193531.description:
I'll teach you the secret to getting along... ♥

(Source: Fakku)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #118

193532.description:
Ruby is a witch! She came to the human world, longing for a romantic relationship like in TV-dramas, but she cast a spell on a human boy, Chise, to turn him into her servant! Whenever she screams, Chise will come to her rescue, no matter where she is!

A magical love comedy that's just too lovely.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 魔女は恋にヘンしてる
title.romaji: Majo wa Koi ni hen Shiteru

title.native: 相姦肉宴・熟母の生下着
title.romaji: Soukan Nikuen Jukubo no Nama Shitagi

title.native: 母親失格 エリート家族の寝取られ転落人生
title.romaji: Hahaoya Shikkaku: Elite Kazoku no Netorare Tenraku Jinsei

193535.description:
Keiji Matsuda is a 39-year-old man who, due to failing health, has become bedridden. Having no friends to help him and his family ostracizing him, Keiji is left with nothing to do but regret his life. Perhaps, he thinks, it would have been better if he was born a girl instead.
The moment he had that thought, he heard a voice out of nowhere and his consciousness fell into darkness…
He woke up to a familiar ceiling, now in the body of a baby. Indeed, Keiji has been reincarnated as Sumire Matsuda - the person he would have been if he was born female. Now given a new opportunity, Sumire decides that she will live life better… and use her good looks to become an actress along the way.

title.native: 美少女にTS転生したから大女優を目指す！
title.romaji: Bishoujo ni TS Tensei Shita kara Dai Joyuu wo Mazasu!

193537.description:
Arato Arakura is a high school student who lives a low-key life, wary of danger. He has the ability to create a thin wall that only he can see, a barrier. One day, a mysterious woman who calls herself Konomi Kirara appears before Arato. She tells him that she and Arato are "EMO users," people whose strong emotions can be transformed into supernatural powers. From this encounter, Arato becomes embroiled in a battle between EMO users, Arato tries to fight through using his barrier, an ability that has zero offensive power.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 円環のエモーションズ

193538.description:
Yura, a company employee, is living with his aloof boyfriend, Kaji, who works as a daycare teacher. Their days are so sweet and affectionate that even a single night apart for a business trip feels unbearable.
One day, a man named Namekawa is transferred to Yura's department — the same man who once made advances on Yura and was driven away by Kaji. Now holding a grudge, Namekawa tries to shake them by saying, “Same-sex relationships ruin your partner’s future.”
While Yura tells himself there's no need to pay it any mind, he can’t help but realize there’s a kind of happiness he can never give Kaji — especially since Kaji loves children...

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra.

title.native: 激甘カレシは仏頂面してやってくる
title.romaji: Gekiama Kareshi wa Bucchouzura Shite Yattekuru

193539.description:
Vanilla Moon is a phantom thief who is making waves all around the world. Her true identity is Komugi, an ordinary middle school student who loves making sweets! Of course, she keeps this a secret from everyone! She accepts requests from people whose precious things were stolen, and she retrieves their treasures from villains! She can't tell anyone, but this time her client is actually a boy she has a crush on...!?

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes six extra chapters.

title.native: スイーツ怪盗バニラムーン

193540.description:
When Eiyu met her childhood friend for the first time in 10 years, she found that he had become a handsome devil! Eiyu had been a hard worker since he was little and could do anything. However, Yuki-chan, who lived next door and was as cute as an angel, was a genius, and Eiyu could never match her. Eiyu was relieved when Yuki-chan moved away, but when Yuki-chan returned after 10 years of transferring schools, she had become an incredibly handsome man! Wasn't Yuki-chan a girl? On top of it all, Yuki also seems to have a really bad personality!

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: 天使なキミは悪魔なカレシ!?
title.romaji: Tenshi na Kimi wa Akuma na Kareshi!?

193541.description:
"That guy switched bodies with me!?"

Hijiri is a strict girl whose only talent is studying. She was supposed to be living an ordinary life, but due to some unexpected events, her body gets swapped with Touya, the super popular idol in her class!? They decide to cooperate with each other for a while, but, especially when dancing and singing are thrown into the mix, they have a series of hard times! What will happen to these two polar opposites!?

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.native: くるくる!チェンジライフ

193542.description: Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Colorful Night Short Story Collection] The Loan Collector

193543.description:
“All kinds of woman walk into his life causing him to be surrounded by beauties!”

In order to live he must get close to girls, what kind of rule is this? Tang Zheng possess the Nine Yang Saint Body, a rare body constitution that is hard to come across within a millennium, yet he must absorb pure Yin energy to stay alive. In order to live, he will fight! Absolute campus belles, goddess teachers, charming housewives, haughty lolis…

(Source: Comikey)

title.english: The Strong, The Few, True Cultivators on Campus

193544.description:
We machines, feeling this way—thinking it's fun, feeling happy, feeling sad... It seems that only very recently in humanity's long history did we become capable of such feelings. Since I was made for humans, if my very existence causes trouble for someone, if it leads to any inconvenience, then this island, littered with discarded junk, is where I belong. I convinced myself of that, and resolved to forget such feelings. But—

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

193545.description:
One day, Jinsuke Amano, a humble businessman, is asked for a divorce by his wife Nana. Left behind with their son Midori, the two embark on a new life through soccer. This groundbreaking "Parent-child soccer life story" is dedicated to those who are facing their dreams, and those who once were!!

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

193546.description:
Kasumi Hashimoto is a laid-back girl who has just entered high school. Kasumi is physically weak and has finally been able to attend school. She is also excited about her new life with the cat-shaped robots Nya-san and Myu-san, but she soon gets caught up in an incident... A high-tension school story unfolds.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

193547.description:
Japan's assassins are controlled by "Kujira" (Japanese for "Whale")...

Kuroo Kitakami lives an ordinary life, unaware of the common knowledge of the underworld. However, when his friends are killed by a mysterious assassin, Kuroo is saved by the assassin Shagura, and upon learning of a conflict to succeed Kujira, Kuroo vows revenge and dives into the seas of ​​hell...

(Source: Shounen Gahousha, translated)

193548.description: An One Shot Published in Comic Baku #2.

193549.description: An One Shot Published in Comic Cue 200.

title.native: 男杉浦 霞を喰らう!!

193550.description:
One day, Naru, who loves animals and is in charge of the creatures, leaves something at school and is forced to pass by the "cursed animal shed". Then, a sign falls and from within appears a huge monster...! Just when she thinks she's going to be eaten, the monster, who calls himself a former great god, proposes to her!? Now that Naru has changed from being in charge of creatures to being in charge of monsters, she is forced to solve strange incidents caused by vengeful spirits while taking care of the former god's black rabbit! What on earth is going to happen next?!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

193551.description:
Ringo's dream is to become a pastry chef and take over her parents' cake shop, Nuts Berry. But one day, Nuts Berry is in danger of closing down!? At that time, a certain customer helps her out, but this person turns out to be someone unexpected...!? You'll be excited to see where Ringo's dreams and love go!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: はつこいデコレーション!

193552.description:
Can first love work out with the power of magic?!

Kiina Natsukawa is worried because her first love, Kou Saionji, won't notice her. Then, a magician named Mero and his familiar Murasaki appear before her! For some reason, they end up helping Kiina with her love life. However, they find themselves suddenly growing closer, unexpected events occur, and the heart-pounding moments don't seem to stop!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

193553.description:
Whether or not humanity should exist... The final vote has been entrusted to Poheko. Winner of the Honorable Mention in Magazine Pocket's 110th Newcomer's Manga Award.

(Source: MU)

title.native: そして私は、こう言った。

193555.description:
Minato, the workaholic president of a company, has nurtured it into a big one. One night, he was unexpectedly told "I like you" by his 9 years younger private driver, Maibara. "I want to see him. I want to hear his voice. I want to tell him to look at me." Before he knew it, even more so than at work, his head was filled with Maibara?! He doesn’t know the shameful side of him yet. It's clumsy, but he falls in love in an honest way. A soft salaryman romance!

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Chapter 1 was previously released as a one-shot in the Koishita Aite ga Otoko datta: BL Anthology (恋した相手が男だったBLアンソロジー).

193556.description: Teruhisa Kusaba, chosen by a young goddess who resembles an android, is reincarnated into another world as a hero. Armed with an inexplicable cheat ability, he begins to conquer the fantasy world of Alvana. Teruhisa constantly questions the incomprehensible and overpowered battles he finds himself in. However, this power is actually the ultimate force he had been seeking all along — the strength to defeat the Overlord in a world that has looped more than 60,000 times!

title.native: 機械仕掛けの最終勇者

193557.description:
Transported to a world where strength reigns supreme, I find myself labeled as talentless. What’s a guy to do? Luckily, I have a card-drawing system that lets me rewrite my destiny! From mecha warrior goddesses to spirited knight maidens, I can summon them all to join the fight!

(Source: Webcomics)

title.english: You Immortal Cultivate, I Draw Cards
title.romaji: Ni Men Xiu Xian Wo Chou Ka

193558.description:
Sousuke Okita of the Okita family was treated badly for being born as the only omega in the family. After overdosing on heat suppressants, he lost consciousness and time-slipped to the late Edo period! There, he met the Vice Commander of the Shinsengumi, Toshizou Hijikata, and was brought to the detention center as "Souji Okita."

Having no other option but to live with the Shinsengumi, Sousuke gradually becomes attracted to Hijikata. Meanwhile, Hijikata continues to mistake Sousuke for Souji Okita.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes "Mibu no Tsugai extra edition (壬生の番い extra edition)" and three extra chapters.

193559.description:
Go ahead... Eat your fill. ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2024-12

synonyms: Black-shain no Tensei-saki wa Dom/Sub Universe no Sekai deshita

title.native: ブラック社員の転生先はDom/Subユニバースの世界でした
title.romaji: Black Shain no Tensei-saki wa Dom/Sub Universe no Sekai deshita

193561.description:
Secret R-Rated training!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2025-03

193562.description:
One day, Mikito collapses from overwork at his exploitative company. When he awakens, he finds himself unexpectedly close to Yanagawa, an elite coworker he barely knew before. He discovers a parallel world where Doms, who thrive on domination, and Subs, who find comfort in being dominated, exist…?! A story of office life and an unexpected connection between a nurturing Dom and a Sub who’s still finding his way!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Black-shain no Tensei-saki wa Dom/Sub Universe no Sekai deshita
Black Shain no Tensei-saki wa Dom/Sub Universe no Sekai deshita: Koibito-hen
ブラック社員の転生先はDom/Subユニバースの世界でした 恋人篇

title.native: ブラック社員の転生先はDom/Subユニバースの世界でした
title.romaji: Black Shain no Tensei-saki wa Dom/Sub Universe no Sekai deshita

193566.description:
The twin brothers love me too much. What should I do?

D-class guide Qiao Yang, because of a drunken accident, discovered that he could use the two A-class sentinels, his childhood friends Zheng Jia and Zheng Yan, to enhance his own class. In order to retain this rare S-class status, he chose to conceal his exploitation of them. However, during the repeated interaction with the two, he gradually becomes aware of their feelings towards him…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Originally serialized under the title “Kao Fa Xiaowo Bianshen Dingji Xiangdao (靠发小我变身顶级向导)”.
synonyms: I Became a First-Class Guide Thanks to My Childhood Friends
靠发小我变身顶级向导
Kao Fa Xiaowo Bianshen Dingji Xiangdao

title.native: 小羊向导从不左右为难
title.romaji: Xiao Yang Xiangdao Cong Bu Zuoyou Weinan

193567.description: A parody 4-koma based on mobile game Break My Case.

193568.description:
"#Space Travel##Transmigration#""Is the most powerful skill in the world one that needs to be actively wielded?"

"Nah, passive skills are the real deal!"

"What are passive skills?"

"A passive skill is an active skill that can be instantly activated. It's an ultimate trump card that no one would guard against and can only be known by the dead!"

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I Have a Body Full of Passive Skills
I Have a Set of Passive Skills

title.english: I Am Loaded with Passive Skills

193569.description:
When Tae-Yul moves to a quiet new town, strange things start happening — a bus drives itself, food is served in a restaurant with no staff, and the sky changes color with the flicker of a streetlight. And each time, a mysterious man chides and saves him before disappearing. But who, or what, could he be?

(Source: Manta)

193570.description:
As the illegitimate child of House Flores, Irenea has been looked down on and mistreated all her life. When she learns that she is to marry the cursed "monster prince" Cesar, she quietly accepts her fate. However, Irenea is shocked to see that he is treated far worse than even a beast. Empathizing with Cesar and realizing that only she can help him, Irenea vows to give him a proper life—as a human. Yet with the whole world against them, can they ever find freedom and happiness?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 怪物皇子が従順なのは皇子妃にだけ
I Tamed the Monstrous Crown Prince

193571.description:
An ordinary aspiring web novel writer, Ji-Kyung Yu. After losing her fiancé in an accident and having her novel filled with her memories plagiarized, she falls into despair and dies… just when she thinks she has completely died, she finds herself possessed by the romance fantasy novel she wrote, Calathea on the Cliff. But… not in the body of the main character, but of the villainess ‘Celestia’! As the original author, Ji-kyung Yu (Celestia + Ji-kyung Yoo) feels an unbearable rage when she sees the content that the plagiarist has arbitrarily changed. She tries to use her rewriting ability, which allows her to change the progression of the novel by revising the content of the book, to create the ending she wants…

Will Ji-Kyung be able to overcome the villains and the plagiarist’s interference in the novel and create the happy ending she wants?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: In This Life I Will Retire

193572.description:
Mafuyu is a very rich and serious girl. But she's actually a delusional idol fan girl. Mafuyu runs away from home, saying, "I can't fantasize about idols at home!", and by chance ends up living in a shared house called "COLORS." What's more, there are idols that Mafuyu loves and admires who live there! In fact, "COLORS" is a shared house exclusively for idols. From now on, she'll be living with live idols every day! This is making Mafuyu's delusions are explode!

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

synonyms: XX a Modest Younger Brother's Friend
XX-ed By a Modest Younger Brother's Friend
正經的年下弟弟不正經

193574.description:
Modern Japan. An era when humans rule over demons. The daughter of a wealthy family, Kurenai, is the heir, but because she is the child of a mistress, she is treated cruelly by her parents and everyone in the mansion. One day, Kurenai picks up a crybaby, timid, and spoiled demon. However, the demon, who she names "Ginga", turns out to be the most feared and evil of all, the legendary "Ju-ten no Oni"!

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

title.native: 泣き虫鬼さん拾いました

193575.description:
If only progressing in life were as easy as leveling up in a game. That’s what happened to James, a game developer who thought his life had hit rock bottom—until his creation began to blur the line between the game and reality.

(Source: Toomics)

193576.description:
Magicians perform magic tricks to entertain the audience, while criminals perform magic tricks to hide their crimes...? Every mystery has a trick or a gimmick! I'm Kurara Genchuu, 14 years old. I'm an aspiring magician. All kinds of incidents happen wherever I go... But no matter how difficult the case, I can solve it elegantly with magic! So, what kind of incident will I encounter today?

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

193577.description:
This secret must never be revealed...

Sakuya Tachibana is the cool beauty of Inorigaoka Private Academy. However, she's actually a huge fan of otome games! While playing otome games in secret as usual, she is discovered by the school's number one refreshingly handsome boy, Hinomiya Asato...!? In exchange for keeping the secret, he makes a contract with her to pretend to be his lover! Will this popular couple find true love with each other?

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

193578.description:
Hitomi is a shy girl who loves visiting the filming locations of her favorite movies. When she transfers to a new school, she meets Akari, who is the polar opposite of Hitomi, cheerful and popular in class. Hitomi admires Akari and begins to fall in love with him. However, Akari has a sad secret...

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

193579.description:
An antique doll named Emily made a wish to have a human heart and fall in love with a human. One day, through the power of God, her wish comes true. However, she must find love with her soulmate before all the roses in the mansion's garden wither. If she doesn't make it in time, she will turn back into a doll. After becoming a human, Emily immediately falls in love at first sight with a boy named Sora Kudou, and intuitively knows that he is her soulmate, but...

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

title.native: ロマンチックアンティーク

193580.description:
The protagonist, Hajime Mukojima, has not had a boyfriend for all 15 years of her life. This year, she is a high school freshman who dreams of meeting someone special. She is very proud of her older brother, Shizuka, who is perfect and can do anything. One day, her childhood friend and first love, Touga Okouchi, transfers to Hajime's school. Hajime feels that this is a fateful reunion and is happy that her long spell without a boyfriend will come to an end, but...

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

193581.description:
After a long battle with illness, Sara passed away, and in order to repay the kindness of her family and friends who supported her during her illness, she decided to live as an angel with the power of blessing. Under the guidance of the Director of the Angel Bureau, Sara was given a partner angel, Tsubasa. However, Tsubasa was known as a problem child in heaven. However, there is a reason why Sara was partnered with Tsubasa... In order for Sara to become an angel, Tsubasa must acknowledge her as his "master." A pure story of love and purification brought to you by a new angel!

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

193582.description:
The protagonists of "Chie Aru Koibito," Ushidome-kun and Shirakaba-san, are both intelligent class representatives who judge things rationally. Even though their classmates extol the two as a perfect match, Shirakaba-san declares that she "doesn't have even a second to lose herself in love." Ushidome-kun is honestly shocked by this, but he also appeals that he is "not in a state to fall in love," which upsets Shirakaba-san. They are both too conscious of each other, and the rationality of the two explosive people is on the verge of collapse. This is the love story of a male and female honor student who cannot be honest with each other and are tormented by their own worldly desires.

(Source: Natalie, translated) _Note: includes 4 extra chapters._

title.native: いっぱい頑張る姫華ちゃん
銀龍蓮華録 お騒がせ公主、龍の番になりました!?
title.romaji: Ginryuu Renge Roku Osawagase Koushu, Ryuu no Ban ni Narimashita!?

193586.description: In the first derby of his career, rookie striker Emilio inadvertently scores a legendary “cock trick” when he headed the ball towards opposing team goalkeeper Won Il’s inner thighs. Despite the news headlines, Emilio doesn’t apologize, and Won-Il is furious. What’s worse, since that day... Won-Il hasn’t been able to get hard. At a cruise party that Won Il is compelled to attend, he has an unexpected reunion with Emilio and receives a heartfelt apology as well as a blow job...

193587.description:
Childhood friends Nam-Ju and Yeo-Ju find themselves stuck in a dungeon, where the only way to escape is to lose their virginity to each other. They’re hesitant at first, until they end up spawning a tentacle monster to help get things started. And get started they do when Nam-Ju sees something squirming in Yeo-Ju’s pants that simply leaves her saying, “You got a tentacle too?!”

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Sex or Die Anthology] Are You a Tentacle There Too?
Is There a Tentacle There Too?
[禁慾即死短篇]難道你那裡也是觸手?

title.english: Do or Die: You Got a Tentacle Too?!

193588.description:
Rebecca, who went undercover as a spy to eliminate the mafia, intentionally approaches Daniela, the only blood relative of the mafia boss. However, as Daniela grows up and her affection for her grows, she begins to lose her sense of purpose and starts to distance herself from her. However, she fails to notice the desire hidden deep in Daniela's heart, and after carrying out the operation, Rebecca's daily life becomes increasingly tangled...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

193589.description:
Jun-Seo, who entered the same university as his senior Si-Woo, whom he had a crush on for a long time, finally decides to confess to Si-Woo, who is liked by everyone regardless of gender or age. However, Ji-Hyeok, a delinquent who keeps appearing around Si-Woo these days, catches his eye... Somehow, their relationship seems unusual?!

"I liked him first..?"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

193590.description:
In the VR game Legend World, people earn money by selling items in the real world, but ordinary player Yak wants more than just making ends meet. Then one day he gets a mysterious reward, Gigantes Dark, a pet-class item worth 1.5 billion won! Finally thinking he's made it, Yak is dismayed to learn that, as a pet, Dark can't be sold. However, as there's no limit to how powerful Dark can become, Yak decides to raise him. Can Yak be a good parent for Dark and rise to the top of the Legend World?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 育ててみたらレアキャラでした
ไม่นึกว่าผมจะได้ไอเทมสุดเจ๋ง
ドキドキ母娘レッスン

title.native: ドキドキ母娘レッスン ~教えて・Hなお勉強~
title.romaji: Doki Doki Oyako Lesson: Oshiete H na Obenkyou

193592.description:
Next, we'll study how mating works. ❤

(Source: Fakuu!)

Note: Published in COMIC Shitsurakuten 2017-04

193593.description:
In a world of secret benefactor and beneficiary relationships, the story of "Daddy-Long-Legs" continues with Andrea Yuriness stumbling upon a perplexing mystery. A serial killer is targeting young women, and the girls at Erta Academy are the most at risk! So she and her dormmates start a student-led investigation in order to protect all the girls on campus. But as someone with a secret benefactor herself, Andrea will soon realize that she has deeper ties to this case than she thought.

(Source: Tapas)

193594.description:
Forty years ago, monster-filled towers appeared, unleashing chaos across the world. Heroes, empowered by spirits, rose to combat the beasts. Jae-Ha Min, a soldier turned civilian investigator, dreams of becoming one of these heroes despite his low aptitude. Everything changes when he accidentally bonds with the spirit of the Heavenly Demon. Now with a powerful mentor inside him, Jae-Ha embarks on a journey to master his newfound abilities and help the demon return home.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 天魔様、俺を英雄にしてください

title.english: I Swallowed the Martial Arts Villain

193595.description: Five chapter spin-off series of Kirio Fanclub.

title.native: 彼女の金髪ママがスケベ過ぎる件
title.romaji: Kanojo no Kinpatsu Mama ga Sukebe Sugiru Ken

193597.description:
After becoming the #1 player in "New World," Ark has lost his drive to play and simply fixes things in the game. One day, the government asks him to help defeat Lucifer, an AI from the game who has escaped to the real world and occupied nuclear generators. Lucifer states that he won't detonate them if Ark joins the new game "Galaxian" and defeats him. Excited to play and take down an old foe, Ark joins the game, but this "legend" can't figure out how to get out of the tutorial stage!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: アーク・ザ・レジェンド

title.native: 友達のママとハメまくる僕
title.romaji: Tomodachi no Mama to Hame Makuru Boku

title.native: ヒーローくんに恋してるっ！

193603.description:
Sanako Kurai, the gloomy girl. She gives off such a negative vibe that her classmates avoid her, but she has a secret hobby. It’s secretly filming the guys’ dicks, a perk of being the wrestling team manager♪ Today, she tries to jerk off to the footage she’s recorded, but the team members catch her and it looks like it’s time for a lecture… or so she thinks, until all the guys surround her with their dicks hanging out… and suddenly, it’s reward fever time♪

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Hotmilk 2025-04

title.native: 性春 ヌきヌきマネージャー

193604.description:
Anzu, Karin, and Lemon Kinoshita are three very ordinary, friendly middle school girls who are sisters. They were living a peaceful life, but one day, the eldest sister, Anzu, was suspected of being a thief! The three sisters set out to find the real culprit, but...!?

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

193605.description:
Remu is a second year middle school student who loves reading. She is troubled by the fact that she cannot be honest with the boy she likes, Riku. One day, she suddenly finds herself transported to the world of her favorite novel, "Happy Princess Precure"!! In this world, Remu becomes a princess, but she is the evil Princess Rem who is imprisoned for the rest of her life at the end of the story! What's more, there is also a Prince Riku who looks just like Riku...!?

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 恋して♥悪役プリンセス！

193608.description:
Feng Chiyin is an eight year-old who suddenly became a sect leader after his grandfather passed away.
Due to his young age, the sect doesn't believe his capabilities, forcing them to leave.
With only two subordinates left on his side, Chiyin must show the martial arts world his strength.

(Source: INKR)

title.english: The Sect Headmaster is Only Eight

193609.description:
Not too far in the future, a cheerful yet slightly shy high school girl named Tenma Ushio receives a message from a mysterious stranger named “Hitoha” that simply said, “I love you.” Though surprised by the first confession she's ever received, Tenma decides to meet the message-sender to decline the offer in person. When she heads off to the arranged meeting place, little does she know that this marks the beginning of a world-shaking event. Girl meets...? A love story unlike any other is about to begin!

(Source: Comic Ogyaaa!!, translated)

193610.description:
Having transmigrated into an ancient world of immortal cultivation, Wu Wang goes on a quest to find a cure for his curse against approaching women. Along the way, he will meet kings and emperors, spirits and youkai, until he finally reaches immortal nirvana.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: This Human Immortal Is Too Serious

title.english: This Divine Human Is Way Too Serious

193611.description:
A collection featuring stories horror and heartwarming laughs. Welcome to the world of Sasaya Nanae!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

1. Zou no Kubi (象の首)
2. Seija ga Ippai (聖者がいっぱい)
3. Chinmoku no Asa (沈黙の朝)
4. Mori no Sato (杜の里)
5-11. Tsurezure Naru Mama ni (徒然なるままに)
12. IMMENSEE
13. Umi yo (La Mer) (海よ（ラ・メール))

193612.description:
College student Kanata (Dom) loves his childhood friend Minato (Sub), who is five years older than him. However, when he was a child, he witnessed his own brother and Minato playing...? Twenty years' worth of love and obsession intersect in this extra thick Dom/Sub universe!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Chapters 1 and 2 were previously published in Volumes 2 and 3 of Collar me Dom/Sub Universe Anthology (Collar me Dom/Subユニバース アンソロジー), respectively.

193618.description:
Haruta Hotaka, who had dreamt of becoming a film director, now spends his days in despair instead. One day, he returns to his hometown for the first time in 12 years for his younger sister's wedding. As he tries to escape the uncomfortable situation, he goes outside and looks up at the sky — only to see mysterious shapes flying in: circles, triangles, and squares.

(Source: LINE Manga, translated)

193619.description:
Hyeon-U Gwak and Jae-Ryeong Jo are members of the National Assembly of South Korea with strong careers ahead of them. They are members of opposing parties and talk each other down in public debates, but at home, they’re a married couple with a lovely seven-year-old daughter! Things get hectic when it turns out that their respective parties have chosen them as presidential candidates. Can they navigate the challenges that lie ahead both in their careers and at home as they run as rivals in a presidential race, and political schemes begin to cloud the horizon?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Loser Is the First Lady

title.english: The Loser Becomes the First Spouse

193620.description:
Facing the miserable end of her life on the street, Alice extinguished the last candle and went back to when everything started to fall apart. Alice was timid and not good with words all her life until she witnessed the sinking of the giant ship Norton with her own eyes. She then realized that when disaster strikes, no one is spared. Alice would do everything in her power to guide her family in making amends.

(Source: Webnovel)

193621.description:
In middle school, Cheol Im was a living legend for his fighting prowess. Years later, he learns that his childhood friend from the orphanage, Sol Kim, was bullied to death. Determined to get revenge, Cheol returns to school. But his plans take an unexpected turn when Ha-yun Seo, a fellow orphan who was like a sister to him, is assigned as a teacher at that very same school. Now, Cheol is forced to choose between his thirst for revenge and his loyalty to the person who once protected him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

193624.description:
"… Would you allow me to touch your beautiful hands?"
"I want to indulge myself in your watery eyes and feel your body temperature."
"My body temperature rises after I drink some blood."
The story of a human domestic and her vampire master.

193625.description: A headstrong policewoman who is investigating Hong Kong's most powerful crime syndicate meets a mysterious man who is also pursuing the same organization. An encounter that will shake up the Hong Kong underworld! A thrill-packed noir action drama.

193626.description: Note: Published in COMIC Magnum Vol. 165

title.native: 犯された帰り道〜好きな人にレイプされました〜
title.romaji: Okasareta Kaerimichi: Suki na Hito ni Rape Saremashita

193627.description:
1. Onsen ni Ikou! (温泉に行こう！, Let's Go to the Onsen!); Comic LO 2025-06
2. Give Me More (ぎぶみーもあ); Comic LO 2024-06
3. Natsu no Kedamono (夏のケダモノ, The Summer Beast); Comic LO 2023-12
4. Imouto wa Gal Bitch Mama (妹はギャルビッチママ, My Little Sister is a Slutty Gyaru Mama); Comic LO 2023-04
5. Inaka no Kodomo wa Hatsu Taiken ga Hayai-rashii (田舎の子供は初体験が早いらしい, Apparently Kids From The Countryside Get Sexually-Active Early); Comic LO 2023-02
6. Hodokeru Oshiri no Ojou-sama (ほどけるおしりのお嬢様, Loosening Up a Tight-Assed Little Lady); Comic LO 2022-11
7. Ai Contact!! (あいコンタクト!!, Love Contact!!); Comic LO 2022-10
