synonyms: 妹はギャルビッチママ
Inaka no Kodomo wa Hatsu Taiken ga Hayai-rashii
田舎の子供は初体験が早いらしい
ほどけるおしりのお嬢様
Saikou no Loli AV wo Torou!!

title.native: ちいさな体がうずいてる

193628.description:
Every night, Jae-Hyuk is visited by an uninvited stranger who leaves him drained in more ways than one. The intruder is Mor, an incubus desperate to survive yet terrible at gathering the energy he needs. What started as nightly harassment ends in an unexpected reversal when Mor is trapped in a binding contract with Jae-Hyuk. One longs for freedom, the other wants a normal life, but their unwanted pact begins pulling their hearts in directions neither expected. With desire blurring every line between them, can they face their tangled feelings and uncover the truth behind their growing attachment?

(Source: Lezhin US)

193629.description:
Leah suddenly becomes a saint. She lives in seclusion in the temple attached to the Academy where she is temporarily entrusted before being announced to the world as a saint after 50 years, but then meets a man in the Academy's quiet Third Library and has a secret meeting...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: The Saint Dreams of a Secret Love

193630.description:
500 years ago, the human and demon realms were divided, causing demons to all but fade from memory. That is, until young Lady Yeonri frees the King of the Dokkaebis, Mujin, from the seal that bound him. Grateful, Mujin pledges to protect Yeonri and bless her clan with eternal prosperity… but as Yeonri grows up with Mujin at her side, she realizes that there’s actually something more she’d like from him…

(Source: Tapas)

193631.description:
The youngest son of the prestigious Kyohou family, Kyo Yeon-Oh, meets a handsome and overwhelming man who comes to Kyohou one day. Kyo Yeon-Oh, who has a bright and warm personality, treats the man, who is somewhat sloppy, as a guest of Kyohou and becomes close to him without hesitation. Then, he learns that the man is a cruel emperor who has mercilessly killed his own blood relatives to ascend to the throne. The emperor came to Kyohou to take a concubine from the Kyo family. Yeon-Oh feels strange thinking that he will become one of his cousins’ concubines… The emperor gives Yeon-Oh a token and asks him to become his concubine. Yeon-Oh becomes the emperor’s concubine, thinking it is love. However, it doesn’t take long for him to realize that his first love was a lie.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193632.description:
Despite repeated attempts, the young King Si-Hyun and Queen So-Young struggle to conceive a child as Si-Hyun seeks to strengthen his position. Under pressure to take a concubine by the Queen Dowager, they try once again. But a perfumed sachet given to So-Young unknowingly ignites the normally cold Si-Hyun's buried desire.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: In the Dark Night, the Silver Moon Shines Coldly

193633.description:
Han-Gyeol meets the man next door by chance and they quickly become close as if they were lost twins. However, as their relationship grows closer, he begins to feel a strange sense of discomfort... What choice will Han-Gyeol make as he is caught in the trap of obsession and madness?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

193634.description:
Erencia Nobelita has been killed and reborn three times, each life ending in tragedy no matter how righteous she tries to be. So she throws caution aside in her fourth loop and decides to live selfishly, but every “evil” choice only wins her admiration and praise. Frustrated and desperate, she sets her sights on Euclid Grethelos, the empire’s most adored Grand Duke, and boldly asks for his hand in marriage. But instead of ruining her life, her audacious plan may have just set the stage for a fate far more unexpected… and irresistible.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Don't Pay Attention to the Villainess

193635.description:
Ji-Hoo and Eugene reunite as PD and writer at a webtoon contest awards ceremony. The two, who were college classmates, did assignments together and even kissed… but Ji-Hoo avoids Eugene’s calls and treats him only as a writer even after becoming his PD. One day, when sharing the storyboard is delayed, Eugene complains about the pain of creation(?) due to his inexperience in dating and proposes a contract relationship to Ji-Hoo…

“I won’t let you go this time.”

Will Ji-Hoo and Eugene be able to finish their work safely?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)
synonyms: Welcome to the Lonely Editorial Department

193636.description:
A sad otaku who always catches only minorities. To her, she finally meets her SNS friend, Mang-I, offline. Mang-I, who has a delicate drawing style and soft emotions… is actually a guy? As if that wasn’t enough, he caused an accident on the first day they met…!!

(Source: Naver Series, translated)
synonyms: About the Fact That My Friend Being a Man

193637.description:
Hyo-Woo, who was hated everywhere because both his eyes were different, was taken in by Sa-Gang and settled in his village. The villagers, who were waiting for rain due to frequent droughts, saw Hyo-Woo's eyes and accused him of being the cause of the droughts. Hyo-Woo develops feelings for Sa-Gang, who was the only one who looked at him kindly amidst all the hatred. However, Sa-Gang, who usually hated rain-making ceremonies, started holding them after Hyo-Woo came, and people started gossiping that they were holding the ceremonies because of Hyo-Woo...

Hyo-Woo's firm faith began to waver as he heard harsh rumors from all sides.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi, Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Prominent-Figures Observation, Record Anthology] Hyou; Dawn Rain
[Macro, Record Short Story Collection] Hyo-woo; Rain at Dawn

193638.description:
Mi-U, an ordinary college student who goes to the same department as her childhood friend Woo-Jin, suddenly encounters a transfer student, Ji-Ha. Mi-U becomes confused when she sees Ji-Ha's face, which seems familiar, overlap with the man who looked at her sadly in her dream. Meanwhile, Ji-Ha becomes anxious as he watches Woo-Jin and Mi-U, who seem close. In fact, he is the Demon King of the Demon World named Lennon. He was wandering through dimensions to find his only lover and rival, Ines, who disappeared after falling into the River of Causality. And finally, he finds traces of her on Mi-U.

"I will protect her even if it means destroying this poor world. Ines is the only one who can move me."

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

193639.description:
“You can’t run away. I’m going to eat you up from now on.”

That night when I witnessed my sister and my boyfriend’s inappropriate relationship, it was just an impulsive one-night stand I chose to soothe my troubled heart…

“I’m Managing Director Kang In-Ha.”

We’re going to meet again as the boss I have to serve from now on. But this man… Doesn’t he remember me? He seems to be used to one-night stands, so I try to control my emotions as he acts calm, but his eyes, his lips, his gestures keep bringing back memories of that day.

“I wondered why she provokes me every time I see her, but it turns out she’s already a woman I’ve fallen for.”

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

193640.description:
As an inept martial artist and a bastard son of the great Ha Clan, Ha Sochan had no choice but to become a vagabond. But his wretched life takes a turn when a mission brings him to the Martial Arts Library, a place filled with the secret techniques of the martial world. There, Sochan is accidentally bound to the library and sent back to when he was 12 years old. Now armed with the library's martial knowledge, he vows to make a name for himself in not only his clan but also the world!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Master of the Martial Arts Library

193641.description:
After her ex-boyfriend dumps her to marry the boss's daughter, Cha Eun-Seo swears off love and gets a job at a rival company for a fresh start. But her plan goes awry when she has a one-night stand with her new sexy CEO, Lee Won-Woo! Eun-Seo runs from the hotel, leaving behind a heel that Won-Woo uses to find her. She wants nothing to do with him, but his interest in her only grows. With such a fervent suitor, can Eun-Weo stay away from love? Or can Won-Woo bring her the happy ending she wanted?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes ten side story chapters.
synonyms: 初体験なので、俺の責任取ってください
ยามรักผลิบาน

title.native: 無能と言われ続けた魔導師、実は世界最強なのに幽閉されていたので自覚なし
title.romaji: Munou to Iware Tsuzuketa Madoushi, Jitsu wa Sekai Saikyou Nanoni Yuuhei Sareteita node Jikaku Nashi

193643.description:
Tomomi Takehara is the second of three sisters and an animation-loving junior high student who has been friends with Busiko and Takubo since childhood. While visiting Eirin High School, they see Ogishima, the star striker of the soccer team, play, and they decide to take the Eirin High entrance exam together. All three manage to pass, but on the day of their junior high school graduation, Tomomi receives a confession of love from Takubo. However, Tomomi mistakenly took it as a joke, and Bushiro, who had been watching from the shadows, got angry with Tomomi. After entering Eirin High School, the three were separated into different classes. and both Bushiro and Takubo became estranged from Tomomi.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

193644.description:
Yuuka has recently started going out with Kouta, the childhood friend she's always had a crush on. Two months into their relationship, they go to Kouta's house to have sex for the first time, but because both of them are inexperienced, it doesn't go well. In front of a troubled Yuuka appears Kouta's younger sister. "Become my ideal girl." A boyfriend, a girlfriend, and his younger sister. It's the start of a love triangle that's so sensual you can't look away, but so immoral that you'll wish you could.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

193645.description:
Secretary Mo Yeon-Hee had never even made eye contact with her boss, Kang Ha-Jun. So imagine Yeon-Hee’s surprise when he calls her to fly out and join him on his business trip for a special task. Everything is going smoothly until… their helicopter suddenly malfunctions, and they are forced to jump! Stranded alone in the jungle, the two must find a way to survive and get back home. Will Yeon-Hee and Ha-Jun be lost forever, or will they find their way out and into each other’s hearts?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 私のボスとジャングルで
ติดป่ากับคุณบอสที่รัก

title.english: In the Jungle With My Boss

193646.description:
Chinami and Shuugo became step-siblings through their parents' remarriage. Their unusually close bond often leads others to say they have a brother complex. After finding out that his older brother is a Sub, Shuugo became incredibly overprotective, which led Chinami to decide to find a partner so he wouldn't be a burden anymore. However, during the partner-finding process, Chinami is suddenly given an order from someone he just met. Somehow, Shuugo, knowing where his brother is and who is supposed to be Normal, saves Chinami from the Dom. Being given soothing orders to calm down, Chinami realizes that Shuugo's commands aren't like the other Dom's, and in fact, they're arousing. After their encounter, Chinami just can't seem to stop reacting to his brother's voice... An affectionate, obsessive younger brother and a kind-hearted, innocent older brother— stepbrothers in a Dom/Sub universe!!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)
synonyms: My Dom Brother Is Full Of Secrets

193647.description:
Never look into the mirror. Because “she” will come for you. From Welzard, creator of “Karada Sagashi”, comes a chilling mirror panic horror!!

At a certain high school, a student suddenly dies under mysterious and inexplicable circumstances. As Natsuki struggles to cope with the death of her friend, rumors begin to spread about a long-standing school ghost story—“Kiriko in the Mirror.”

Determined to uncover the truth behind the string of bizarre deaths and the legend of Kiriko, Natsuki begins her own investigation. But soon, she finds herself in danger as well…!

This work is a manga adaptation of “Kyōkaisen,” originally published on the novel platform Everystar.

title.romaji: Ame no Hi, Sensei no Iede

193649.description:
A blizzard falls from the sky and tears open the ground, and with it, a giant unidentified monster, “Agwi,” appears! A story about three siblings who protect each other in the endless winter after the apocalypse.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 変態黒髪ちゃんと生涯モブの僕
title.romaji: Hentai Kurokami-chan to Shougai Mob no Boku

193651.description:
When Crown Prince Vincent announces their engagement is over, Elizabeth faints. What will become of House la Montlivere? Of her entire family? At the prince’s side, the so-called heroine smirks. Elizabeth is doomed to a villainess’ fate… Only for the tables to turn when Vincent suddenly calls out the heroine for her misdeeds!

Jump into the story of an ill-fated but handsome prince as he fights for his darling fiancée, deflecting every attempt to turn her into an evildoer by any means necessary! They’ll have their lovey-dovey happily ever after, even if it kills him!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)
synonyms: Lovestruck Prince! I’ll Fight the Heroine for My Villainess Fiancée!

title.native: ベタ惚れの婚約者が悪役令嬢にされそうなので。
title.romaji: Betabore no Konyakusha ga Akuyaku Reijou ni Saresou nanode.

193652.description:
The smell of my beloved makes me feel horny... ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2015-02

title.native: めちゃくちゃ地雷っぽいけど根は優しそうな子
title.romaji: Mechakucha Jiraippoi kedo Ne wa Yasashisou na Ko

title.native: ゴブリンちゃんとまったり過ごす発情期。

193655.description:
In the towering kingdom of Urunaria, society is literally built on inequality. The wealthiest reside at the top, while the poor are confined to the dark, crumbling depths below. For Kuro, a young slave raised by his uncle in the lowest levels, life offers no future - only labor, loss, and silence. But when his uncle is executed by the state, Kuro inherits a mysterious device: Gizmo - a pair of mechanical gloves with the power to grip, scale, and defy the very system built to crush him.

Armed with nothing but this outlawed tool and his burning desire for freedom, Kuro begins his ascent, both up the tower and against a society that deems him worthless.

(Source: Titan Manga)

title.native: ボツ漫画「可愛い奥様」のご供養まとめ本+α
title.romaji: Botsu Manga "Kawaii Okusama" no Gokuyou Matome Hon + α

193659.description:
To solve the family crisis, Li Weiyin had no choice but to marry Xu Yimo, the young master of the Xu family, whose IQ equals that of an eight-year-old child. On the first day after they got married, her cute husband was clingy to her and said, "Weiyin, I'll be a very good boy. You must love me very much." On the second day, however, her husband became aloof and didn't care about her, saying, "Relax. I'm not interested in that blockhead's wife." On the third day, her husband became a gentleman wary of her and asked, "Who are you? Why are you in my room?" On the fourth day, her husband acted frivolously and made eyes at her, saying, "Tell me, which of the three of them married you?" Li Weiyin finally realized that her husband was more a man with a multiple personality disorder than a blockhead.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.native: ふたりが幸せになっていく姿を見るくらいなら死んだほうがいい。
title.romaji: Futari ga Shiawase ni Natteiku Sugata wo Miru Kurai nara Shinda Hou ga Ii.

193661.description:
My ex-boyfriend is sitting across from me right now, which is the craziest thing of all! This is a blind date gone wrong! Can it be any more awkward? Is there a kind of fate at work, or is there something funny going on?

(Source: WebComics)

193662.description:
Hime is a scatterbrained girl who barely gets by at school with the help of her best friend Yumeka. Until one day, when Hime decides to start standing up for herself, after she meets a special girl—.

(Source: Manga Time Kirara, translated)

Note: This is a reworked full serialization version of a previous short series.

193663.description:
Yuki is a school nurse with a past that turned her off from theater. Until two first-year students, Mikoto and Kaya, approach her with a desire to start a Theater Club. Despite Yuki’s cold attitude, the two ask her to watch a play they want to perform…

(Source: Manga Time Kirara, translated)

193664.description:
Saku, the school's most notorious delinquent, has a secret. Along with his older sister and his childhood friend, Saku is part of the three-person live-streaming crew known as the Tebasaki Sisters. During their streams, Saku dresses as a girl to hide his true identity, with twin-tails and cute outfits as his trademark look. One day, Saku is forced to go outside while cross-dressing. There, he runs into his classmate Mizuki, a cool beauty who always seems to be picking on him at school...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: うそつきトワイライト

193665.description:
Chizuru Watatori is on her way to her first day of high school, when she is told by a fortune teller that “Yamada is your destiny.” At the entrance ceremony, she meets a Yamada that she likes, and Chizuru starts thinking that it might really be fate. However, it turns out that all of her classmates except for herself have the surname Yamada. The story unfolds as Chizuru gets to know all the various Yamadas in search of The One.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Note: Originally a three-chapter short-series, it was picked up for continuing serialization on 2025-04-08.

title.native: 運命のヤマダダダダダダダダダダ

193666.description:
Mochida, a junior high boy, had a crush on Aoyama, the most beautiful girl in his class. However, while he was secretly masturbating in the library thinking of her, he was caught by Hira, the library committee member on duty. Caught red-handed, Hira suddenly demanded a kiss from Mochida. Before he could react, Mochida lips were touching hers and it caused him to ejaculate. She invited him to join the secret “Kissing Club.” A story about the debauchery of their youth, as they become obsessed with the forbidden fruit.

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

193667.description:
I should not be falling in love with this person...
Enemy or lovers? The fiercest rivals in history return!

Ryunosuke Akechi is the school's toughest delinquent, while Maria Oda is the beautiful idol of the school.
Two people who live in different worlds, they start going out after Akechi confesses his feelings.
However, when they kiss for the first time, memories of the fiery betrayal at Honnouji fill their heads...!

A turbulent high school life begins, as their present-day love affair becomes intertwined with grudges from the past!

(Source: Morning, translated)

title.native: 織田ちゃんと明智くん

193668.description:
Natsumi and Souta started working for the same company at the same time. Ever since, they've enjoyed countless "meatings," where they eat barbecue and gush about how delicious it is. They're super close, but Natsumi never thought their relationship would develop into something romantic. That is, until she sees Souta with another woman... Now, her chest feels tight and she doesn't know what to do. When Natsumi tells Souta her worries at their next "meating," he suddenly seems a lot more manly than he ever has before... Is he going to consume her, body and all!? This juicy rom-com centers around a red-blooded couple's heated love that blooms from a searing barbecue!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Let Me Consume It All. -The Love Affair of a Carnivore-
title.native: 全部、食わせろ。―肉食系の恋愛事情―
title.romaji: Zenbu, Kuwasero.: Nikushokukei no Renai Jijou

193669.description:
A collection of short stories related to the Chinese Zodiac published in Canna Vol. 21.

1. Eto Sou 2012 (干支荘2012, Zodiac Signs Manor) [Akira Honma]
2. Shuu-chan no Nengajou (しゅーちゃんの年賀状, Shuu-chan’s New Years Greeting Card) [Hiroi Takao]
3. Ichizu na Puppy (いちずなパピィ, Earnest Puppy) [Lily Umiyuki]
4. Hitotose Futari (ひととせふたり, A Couple Once Upon a Year) [Hal Suzukura]
5. Okaeri, Itterasshai (おかえり、いってらっしゃい, Welcome Home, Have a Safe Trip) [Mito Hanamori]
6. Sarainen Date Shimashou ne ♡ (再来年デートしましょうね♡, Let's Have a Date the Year After Next ♡) [Fuu Aikawa]

193671.description:
A straight-laced researcher bottom with a hot-and-cold personality finds himself experimenting with his own body to study the unique functions of the puppy-like sexdroid top he lives with all on his day off, and with plenty of loving sex.

Note: Released at J.GARDEN 55.

193672.description:
A threesome story featuring a doting top, a virgin puppy-like top, and a straight-laced bottom with a hot-and-cold personality. Robot developer Eiji lives with an android named Theo, but they're caught having sex by Theo's identical android copy, Theo Two. Before he knows it, Eiji ends up giving Two a hands-on sex education using his own body?!

Note: Released at J.GARDEN 56.

193675.description:
One day, the protagonist, who hunts yetis for a living, meets a yeti girl who can speak. When the two people, who have both lost loved ones, meet, their hearts begin to move... A heartwarming human drama recommended for cold days.

(Source: Shonen Jump+, translated)
synonyms: マイリトルフットロード

193677.description:
One day, as they were celebrating each other's birthdays and exchanging useless gifts like an annual event, Cheong-Hee discovered that the strangely shaped toy he had given as a gift smelled like Ha-Hyun.

"...Show me how to use my gift."

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

193679.description:
Mellie never fooled herself into believing she was more than a mere burden. Since childhood, she had been a leech to House Felton who relied on her mother’s friendship with the former Duchess Felton. Even so, it was inevitable that she came to harbor feelings for her most cherished playmate, Young Master Edric. But things start to change when Edric gets engaged. The former duchess begins treating her coldly, and her childhood friend insists that she remains by his side forever. Mellie has never had agency over her own life. But surely Edric has her best interests in mind, right...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: My Husband and I Cannot Live in the Same World
title.native: 公爵夫人は逃げる～夫と生きる世界が違い過ぎて～
title.romaji: Koushaku Fujin wa Nigeru Otto to Ikiru Sekai ga Chigaisugite

193680.description:
During a mission gone wrong, Yeon Yoo’s subordinate Ryoong is infected with the zombie virus — but he’s… different. He doesn’t hunger for flesh. He doesn’t turn mindless. The only thing he seems to be craving is... Yeon. If he’s not a zombie, then what could he have possibly turned into?

(Source: Manta)

193681.description:
A booklet packaged with Harta volume 2 at select stores. It's an anthology of one-shots from Harta collaborators focusing on the theme of cats.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

193682.description:
Son Je-Wan was a rising star in the broadcasting world until he suddenly lost the ability to recognize faces. The loss forces him to rebuild his career as a freelancer and for three long years, every face was a blur. One day, he finally recognizes someone, Lee Jin, an assistant writer at a TV station he'd bumped into before having face blindness... whose name is also written on Je-Wan's body! Determined to reclaim his place at the top, Je-Wan proposes a contractual relationship with Jin, but things soon spiral far beyond what either of them expected...

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ระหว่างความเข้าใจและความเข้าใจผิด

193683.description:
A booklet packaged with Fellows! volume 22 at select stores. It's relay manga (each mangaka draws a few panels, and the next mangaka continues the story) from Fellows! collaborators. Originally published in 2012 volume 3 of Gessan, this plus version includes extended commentary by each of the involved creators and a highlight commentary by Satoshi Fukushima who oversaw the manuscripts.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: 合作漫画 フェローズのできるまで +(PLUS)Edition

title.native: フェローズのできるまで +(PLUS)Edition
title.romaji: Fellows no Dekiru made PLUS Edition

193684.description:
To spice up their stale relationship, Hye-Seong and Seung-Ju decide to bring a third man into the mix. But things take an unexpected turn when their guest turns out to be I-Nu - Seung-Ju’s junior from college and his longtime secret admirer. As Hye-Seong grows jealous of the tension between Seung-Ju and I-Nu, things heat up in more ways than one…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: วิกฤตรักของสามเรา

title.english: Two's Company, Three's a Good Time

title.native: 最高のセカンドライフ

193687.description:
Omega Yang, who has a special constitution that makes it difficult for him to lead a normal life due to the heat cycle that explodes without warning. In the end, he is unable to control his pheromones and gets fired from the company by CEO Jin Se-Ryuk. While he is sobbing and drinking to calm his mind, he catches a taxi that is passing by in a hurry due to the heat cycle that explodes again . For some reason, he gets excited by the alpha pheromones that fill the car. Unable to distinguish that the person in front of him is not a taxi driver but Se-Ryuk, he ends up asking for a favor that he shouldn't do...

"Sir, can you help me."

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

193688.description:
Dan-Ho, who needed money due to his ex-boyfriend's threats, inadvertently participates in a cosplay competition that he told her about. The host of the competition, streamer Magikun, senses Dan-Ho's talent for broadcasting the moment he sees him and offers him as a guest on his channel. Dan-Ho is tempted by the 5 million won per appearance fee, but...? When he visits Magikun's house for rehearsal, all he finds are adult products, restraints, and cosplay costumes!

"Was this by any chance an adult broadcast?!"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

193691.description:
A sweet revenge brought about by a misunderstanding begins!

Yu-Na, who has failed to register for classes and entered an unfamiliar classroom, bumps into Jung-Woo, who looks exactly like her best friend Ji-Soo's playboy ex-boyfriend, and they kiss by an unexpected accident. Jung-Woo misunderstands Yu-Na's actions due to his past experiences(?) and says, "I'll date you," so Yu-Na plans a grand revenge of 'seducing and dumping'...

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Includes 15 side story chapters.

title.native: Wさくらちゃんのふわとろさんど!

193693.description: Note: Published in COMIC Magnum Vol. 153

title.native: 探偵気取りと不機嫌な青春

193695.description:
At a formal marriage meeting, omega Seo-Ho drops a shocking bombshell... he’s pregnant. But there’s a twist: the father isn’t his fiancé, but a complete stranger he only met the night before. That stranger is Eun-Hyun, a wealthy alpha from a powerful family. With no time to backtrack, Seo-Ho is forced into a fake engagement with him, a contract bound by secrets, lies, and complicated emotions. As they navigate family expectations, public scrutiny, and their own tangled feelings, tension simmers between them. Can this accidental couple survive the chaos they’ve unleashed, or will their carefully built house of cards come crashing down?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Reversal of the Twist of the Inversion

193696.description:
A girl raised by the dragon god becomes host to an unspeakable malice. She must find a way to defy it and save the gods!

The dragon god is like a father to Yatori, an orphaned girl who lives and works at his shrine. One day, the emperor’s son Toyokitsu, who bears the same golden eyes as the dragon god, arrives in search of the deity. On the way to meet the god, they are attacked by a tiger god enshrouded with a strange black mist. After the fight, Yatori touches a mirror shard she finds next to the tiger. In an instant, a malevolent being manifests and leaves a curse mark on her cheek, vowing to use her as its host until she restores its power.

(Source: Square Enix)

193697.description:
In a world of humans and beastfolk...
After Masora, a human college student, discovers that his best friend may have not actually been his friend at all, he starts to feel insecure about how naive and inept he is.
In hopes of improving himself as a person, he decides to start working at a ski resort part-time.
That's where he meets another part-time worker, a husky-hybrid beastman around the same age named Kohaku.
From the moment they meet, Masora feels that Kohaku is a cold, terrifying man, and he begins to worry that he won't be able to survive his new part-time job, until one day...
A love story between an unsociable beastman and a clumsy human.

title.english: With The Dog Comes the Spring
title.native: 犬来たりなば春遠からじ

193698.description:
This is the story of a world where if you're a virgin until you're 30, you become a real wizard.

A world where the magical phenomenon 'explosion of sexual desire' and the 'wizards' who fight against it coexist. Hae-Sung, who has lived as a virgin until his 30s due to erectile dysfunction, accidentally finds out that he has great talent as a wizard, and becomes a wizard duo with Do-Hyun, whom he thought was his one-night stand partner... Wait a minute. My weapon is my partner's precious "XX"?

"I don't need this kind of talent! I don't want to do it~!!"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

193700.description:
What’s a little fondling between best friends? After accidentally grasping Baek-Gyung’s silky smooth sack, Jeong-Min can’t get the sensation out of his head. To him, the obvious solution is to create increasingly absurd situations where his hands might get to hold his friend’s luscious goods. Meanwhile, Baek-Gyung is enjoying Jeong-Min’s attention in a way he can’t quite pin down, but he’s sure there’s a legitimate, wholesome reason their relationship is suddenly so...intimate.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: เพื่อนสนิทคิดไม่ซื่อ

193701.description:
He teleports away from troublesome matters, human relationships, and public opinion - anything he wants to escape from. However, he is unable to rid himself of the junior colleague who keeps following him around, so he makes a suggestion. What does he find at the end of his escape?

(Source: Shonen Jump+, translated)

title.native: 山下タクミがよく逃げる
本日も母と妹の調教日和
title.romaji: Honjitsu mo Haha to Imouto no Choukyou Hiyori

193703.description:
The grand prize-winning work from the "Alternate World Fantasy Manga Original Story Contest" is finally being adapted into a manga!

Eris, a sacred florican who grants people's wishes with flowers, is imprisoned one day for attempting to curse and kill the first prince, Willard. With the help of Willard, who miraculously survives, Eris is able to prove her innocence, but Willard has only been partially cursed and turned into a half-beast. Eris is determined to save Willard, but it seems the only way she can find to break the curse is to kiss her...!?

A heart-pounding love fantasy in which the half-beast prince can't stop doting on her!

(Source: Pixiv, translated)
synonyms: この度、聖花術師から第一王子の臨時(？)婚約者になりました

title.native: この度、聖花術師から第一王子の臨時(？)婚約者になりました ～この溺愛は必要ですか！？～
title.romaji: Kono Tabi, Kiyokajutsushi kara Daiichi Ouji no Rinji (?) Konyakusha ni Narimashita:  Kono Dekiai wa Hitsuyou desu ka!?

title.native: 君は春までぼくのいぬ
title.romaji: Kimi wa Haru made Boku no Inu

title.native: キミの甘さじゃときめかない

193709.description:
A first love's kiss will break the curse!? On her 14th birthday, Suzu is cursed to turn into a dog if she's splashed with water! The only way to break the curse is to kiss her first love. Suzu's first love, Ayumu, is her childhood friend, but he's kind to everyone and is the most popular boy in school! And on top of that, he dumped her three years ago...

Will Suzu be able to win him over and break the curse?

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

193710.description:
A story of love and family life that transcends differences and is woven under one roof between a complicated heir and a commoner girl! Ai, who is left alone at home when her father is transferred overseas, ends up staying at the mansion of her father's friend, who runs the Mikado Group. When his son, Reiji, says, "What, you're just a commoner," their new living arrangement gets off on the wrong foot. But as they spend time together, they gradually realize each other's kindness.

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

193711.description:
Super Love Theory: secret data and techniques created by studying human psychology. It is said that if you use it, any love can come true... Kanae decides to use the Super Love Theory to make things work out with her unforgettable first love, Danmu. However, other boys also come on to her, and unexpected things happen one after another!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: ずるい恋の叶え方〜恋愛超理論〜
title.romaji: Zurui Koi no Kanaekata: Renai Chou Riron

193712.description:
Beauty streamer Yuniko makes everyone's dreams come true with the power of makeup!

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

193713.description:
Ruka is 14 years old. Today, she's going to marry the man of her dreams! She's going to live with of Miyabi-kun, who she promised to marry 8 years ago. But when she meets him again, he's become a really cool guy... Is Ruka the only one who remembers their marriage promise? But he helps her out when she's in trouble, and even says things like "It's fun being with you, Ruka"!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: キュンとさせんで雅くん

193714.description: A short and sweet love story between an alpha beastman and his omega human soulmate husband whose health doesn't allow them to become mated, no matter how much they may wish to.
synonyms: Every Day is a Good Day When There's Love

title.romaji: Nichinichi kore Koujitsu, Ai Koukou to

193715.description:
The story follows 17-year-old Rinko Isumi, who has left home and is trying to support herself with multiple part-time jobs. A twist of fate leads her to become a mercenary, and under the guidance of veteran mercenary Nagisa Mizusaki, she throws herself into conflict in a foreign land.

(Source: Twitter, translated)

193716.description:
The genius artist Lu Zhiyun was raised in neglect since childhood, until she finally returned to the capital. Already past prime marriageable age, she throws herself into various matchmaking parties amongst the nobles of the capital, as arranged by her parents. But Pei Chongjin, commander of the imperial guards, secretly does everything he can to make sure that he'll be the only man for Lu Zhiyun.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

193717.description:
A demonic invasion has put humanity's survival at risk. Until a generational "genius" appeared. The genius told them, "No, don't help me up. Really. I think better when I'm lying down. It's an old habit! I'm not falling asleep!" After all, laziness is a basic human trait. If we could turn laziness into power, humanity's future will be assured.

(Source: Webnovel)

193718.description:
On Christmas Eve, Hayan sneaks into her boyfriend’s luxury apartment, only to tumble into a dangerously tempting mistake with a tattooed stranger who isn’t him. What should have been a simple surprise turns into a forbidden encounter, leaving both of them caught between guilt, thrill, and irresistible desire.

(Source: Lezhin US)

193719.description: The series tells the story through the eyes of Ogino, from the beginning of his career as a young train conductor in Osaka in the late 1940s to his involvement in the national railway's struggles that eventually led to privatization and breakup.

193720.description:
Pay attention, this man's name is A-wei! He thought he had transgressed into the body of the [Number One Villain] in the martial world, but he actually turned out to be a super weakling with a combat strength of [Zero]! A-wei, who fancied himself a wolf but was more like a husky, advanced by leveraging his extraordinary confidence to cut through challenges effortlessly. Concealing his identity, building his power base, reclaiming his former beautiful subordinates, and training his cute and clever apprentice... did he really become the [Number One] in the martial world?!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I Became a Big-Shot on the Heavenly Leaderboard
I Never Take Action And Become a Big Boss in the Sky
I Never Take Action, Yet I Was Ranked as One of the Strongest On the Skyboard

title.english: Without Making a Move, I Became The No.1 Master
title.native: 从不出手的我混成了天榜大佬
title.romaji: Congbu Chushou De Wo Hun Chengle Tian Bang Dalao

193721.description:
Nebi, the chief saintess of the Holy Order, is forced to bear the heavy responsibility of fighting against the demon race. But Tatos, the feared leader of the demons, desires an intimate relationship with her. Tilo, the knight assigned to protect her, lacks common sense and insists on being guarded 24/7 and is even willing to give his body. Nebi originally wanted to hide, but did not expect that Tatos turned into a human appearing in the Holy Order, using various ways to lure her into his trap…

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The Coquettish Devil King by Name Asked Me to Be His Princess

title.english: The Sultry Demon King Wants Me
title.native: 风骚魔王点名要我做王妃
title.romaji: Fengsao Mowang Dianming Yao Wo Zuo Wangfei

193722.description:
Aspiring to be a science-popularizing content creator, Xie Pu transmigrates to a different world—a place where only women possess magic, and magic equals productivity and power! Starting with a disastrous situation, Xie Pu teams up with the weak and impoverished lord, the "Calamity Witch" Lena. Unexpectedly, he rises to prominence, spreading science and spearheading production and construction in this new world. A double harvest of career success and romance?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)
synonyms: I Said I'd Make Science Content... So Why Are All My Fans Witches?!
I Wanted to Do Science Outreach, but All My Fans Turned Out to Be Witches?
You Promised to Popularize Science, But All Your Fans Are Witches?
I Said I’d Do Science Popularization, But All My Fans Are Witches?

title.native: 说好做科普，粉丝却全是魔女？
title.romaji: Shuohao Zuo Kepu, Fensi Que Quan Shi Monu?

193723.description:
“Should I stop? There’s already a mess inside you.”

Won-Young, who suspected frigidity, goes to see his friend Yeon-Woo for treatment.

“No! That’s not it. It hurts. It really hurts.”
“Yeah.”
“Don’t take it out. Keep going.”

The thrilling sensation that comes every time the black nitrile gloves pass between her legs. Won-Young can’t hold back a moan at the leaking love juice.

“Right now, I think I’m going to go. So do something about it.”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Deotitong Danpyeonseon (더티톡 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Dirty Talk Anthology] Urology Department in Front of Obstetrics and Gynecology Department

193724.description:
Hardy works as a proxy driver of magic carriages until a shady request sends him to the wedding of Hysterion's infamous young heir. Forced to crash the ceremony, Hardy is stunned when Abel Hysterion, the center of every scandal, points straight at him and declares, "Here comes my bride."

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: What Happens When the Single Coachman Becomes the Substitute

title.english: What Happens if a Driver Is Unmarried

193725.description:
Sierra Delight, the fierce heiress of the Black Panther clan, is forced into an arranged marriage with Luhan White, the heir of the Rabbit clan. Expecting a fragile, trembling husband she can easily intimidate into a divorce, Sierra enters the bridal chamber with low expectations. However, Luhan completely shatters her assumptions. While he remains perfectly innocent and docile during the day, he transforms into an unhinged, insatiable beast at night. Soon, Sierra realizes Luhan is nothing like the gentle bunny she anticipated.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: There's No Way I'd Be Satisfied With a Rabbit Husband!

title.english: Never SATISFIED WITH My Bunny Husband!

193726.description:
Eleanor Mecklen was never more than a political pawn who married into the prestigious House Mecklen of the Barden Empire. Under the scrutiny of her mother-in-law, Duchess Carolyn, Eleanor endured endless humiliation. But when Carolyn meets an untimely death, Eleanor is accused of murder and sent to the executioner’s block. But death does not claim her. Instead, she reawakens at House Mecklen. Armed with the knowledge of what’s to come, Eleanor has a second chance to seize her fate.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: メクレン公爵夫人の華麗なる逆襲
梅克伦公爵夫人的优雅叛乱

1-6. Ushiro no Manazashi (うしろのまなざし)
7-8. Shui Hana (朱い花)

私が大好きな小説家を殺すまで

193736.description:
"Bijin Sugiru Josou Keiji Toudou-san" is a detective comedy that begins when the talented detective Toudou cross-dresses for an undercover operation, but it proves to be so effective that he starts working in drag all the time. Toudou's beautiful cross-dressing attracts everyone, making his colleagues feel flustered even though they know he is a man, and causing a big commotion and a great success, ruining the life of a yakuza who calls himself Toudou's rival.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 美人すぎる女装刑事 藤堂さん

193737.description:
Komaki is a pro wrestler who brings down a rain of blood and tears.
She is a vicious wrestler, but she is also a mother raising a baby!
She continues to fight at the ring at work and in the playpen at home!
The gong of this exhilarating child-rearing comedy is about to ring!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Working Wrestling Mama: Becoming a Villain Wrestler Mom

title.native: ＷＷＭ -極悪レスラー、ママになる
title.romaji: WWM: Gokuaku Wrestler, Mama ni Naru

193738.description: Note: A live-action AV adaptation (URE-010) was released on September 5th, 2013.

193739.description:
"Please find the person who killed me—Detective."

July, ■th. On a summer day when the mysterious and beautiful girl, Momiji Reido, transferred to our school, a classmate was murdered. It was a locked-room murder.

“Let’s solve the case together, Amami-kun.” “You sound just like a famous detective from a mystery novel.”

I, Haruma Amami, a member of the nearly-disbanded Literature Club, was somehow asked by the transfer student to investigate the case. And then, Reido was killed—or so it should have been. Inside the ultimate locked room, one that no one could possibly solve.

"Please find the person who killed me—Detective."

An immortal detective and his “ordinary” partner. A school mystery that takes on an impossible murder—begins now!

(Source: GA Bunko, translated)

Note: Winner of the Grand Prize in the 15th GA Bunko Newcomer Award.

193740.description:
Two cute students partake in erotic sexscapes with their teacher. Rurika and Chitose are longtime friends. They both love their teacher, confessed their love for him together, and are in a polygamous relationship. ...And after studies, they enjoy plenty of sex with sensei!

(Source: DLsite)

Note: Released at Comiket 102

title.native: るりかとちとせとせんせいと
title.romaji: Rurika to Chitose to Sensei to

193741.description:
"Anyone who lives in this mansion will die, including you, who are watching this diary now.

A bonding story spun by a single car.

A 1954 Volkswagen Beetle runs through Showa, Heisei, and 2025.

Her father used to be violent and would spew intense anger at home. Now his cancer has returned and he is bedridden at home. With a 92% match rate, the highest in the Center’s history, Esper Gye Joon-Min and Guide Won Yoo-Gyul were supposed to be the perfect pair. For years, Yoo-Gyul struggled with his unrequited feelings for Joon-Min, believing the esper could never be his unless he forgot the guide he had imprinted on nine years ago. Yet, as time goes by, he begins to realize that perhaps hope is not lost. Will Yoo-Gyul and Joon-Min ever experience the kind of tender, heartfelt guiding that other pairs take for granted?

At his grandfather’s funeral, Aaron meets a man named Joseph, who claims to have been his grandfather’s student. Drawn to the mysterious charm of Joseph, Aaron ends up dating him, but soon after, he begins to have recurring dreams featuring a strange man...

And he can’t shake the feeling that the man in his dreams somehow resembles Joseph?!

193865.description:
After her grandmother passed away, Na Su-Hyeon returned to her hometown after settling down in the city. As if drawn by something, Su-Hyeon climbs 'Obongsan', which her grandmother had told her never to climb while she was alive. When she gets lost in the mountains and is caught up in strange events and is in danger, Su-Hyeon receives help from a man named Seo Moon-Ju, who is still fine even after being beheaded... Moon-Ju tells her that Su-Hyeon is the reincarnation of her former divine mother, the shaman Kang Yu-Hwa, and that the strange events that are unfolding before her eyes happened because Su-Hyeon climbed Obongsan. Moon-Ju finds this very suspicious, but after she encounters ghosts who steal the weapons buried in Kang Yu-Hwa's grave and gain power, Su-Hyeon feels a sense of responsibility. Moon-Ju speculates that the 'evil spirit' that drove Kang Yu-Hwa to death in the past must have been moved by Su-Hyeon's energy and dug up her grave. In the end, Su-Hyeon decides to listen to the voices of the ghosts and retrieve the five weapons together with Moon-Ju..

193919.description:
In a world of eternal night and blood moons, the steampunk land is shrouded in eerie mist, with humanity mutating and a wall of flesh devouring lost souls amid constant wails. At this time, a lone strategist named Annan rises as the “Number One Player” to become the savior of the Mist Continent. Leading the Thirteen Saints and forming alliances with the Twelve True Gods, he carves out a new future. Declaring himself a “Champion of Justice” and the gatekeeper of the Fourth Calamity, he takes on the mantle of an uncrowned god to calm fears, guide people through the unknown, and face the challenges of this chaotic world together.

(Source: Webnovel)

193920.description:
Marrying your childhood best friend and first love may sound like a dream come true – but not for Renee. After marrying into a contract marriage with Alexander, Renee faces all sorts of trouble, but none can match her own husband’s cold shoulder. However, a magical wish might change everything. Can a simple wish save Renee’s failing marriage?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The End of a Fake Marriage

193921.description:
All Makoto wants to do is to break up with his boyfriend, but he just keep getting more addicted to him?! After a night of drinking, Makoto unexpectedly starts dating Yagi. Determined to end things, Makoto has tried to break up over 50 times, but all his attempts have failed. If this continues, he'll have to do whatever it takes to make Yagi hate him. Yagi claims he doesn't like aggressive people, so Makoto tries to use that to his advantage... but everything backfires! And just like that, things take an unexpected turn...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Trying to Break up With Sex
title.native: 別れるために色仕掛けしてみた

193922.description:
Haruto is an ordinary, lonely and soft hearted boy. After a certain encounter with Tsujimoto Naru, a popular idol who attends the same school’s performing art’s department, he suddenly began to hear his thoughts! Naru’s cold words and cool attitude makes Haruto unsteady… but what he hears from his heart is a voice filled with sweetness, saying “He’s so cute!”

(Source: ShuCream, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
193922.hashtag: #狼くんの愛はちょっと不機嫌
synonyms: Wolfy boy's love is a little moody

title.native: 狼くんの愛はちょっと不機嫌
title.romaji: Ookami-kun no Ai wa Chotto Fukigen

title.native: 「僕はすべてを知っている」番外編集
「目黒と秋野は気づかない」番外編集

193926.description:
"Cumming while making a pathetic sound."
A sickeningly sweet, BL love story about discipline between a dog with a peculiar kink and a devoted delinquent!

Belligerent university student Haru has unrequited feelings for his caring childhood friend Suzu. Haru imagines Suzu roughing him up until he passes out, until one day Suzu nonchalantly shares his desire to be a pleasure master! Suzu wants to find someone to practice on and Haru puts his hand up with ulterior motives. Can Haru handle the unimaginable S-tier discipline from Suzu - a man so cute that he triggers a woman's maternal instincts?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: If You Want to Discipline Someone, Choose Me
title.native: 躾けたいならオレにしろ

193927.description:
Abnormality in his physical exam, a delay in cognitive function, missing memories, Lu Chen was enveloped by mysteries. Just as he was ready to return to the top after unlocking a special role, another twist of fate emerged...

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: 网游之天下无双【重制版】
Unparalleled in the Online Gaming World

193928.description:
Cheong-Yeon is an academic legend with a soul of ice. To save his college applications from a failing character evaluation, he agrees to mentor Su-Han, the school’s most notorious troublemaker. Su-Han earns nothing but zeroes and lives with zero motivation. While Cheong-Yeon only wants his college recommendation, Su-Han just wants to be left alone. As they clash over study habits and life choices, the top student begins to find his missing empathy and emotions in the most unexpected place.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

193929.description:
Yoon is a free agent, using his extraordinary strength and cunning for any job that comes his way—legal or otherwise. But when a crucial mistake plunges him headfirst into the world of a shadowy crime network known only as the “platform,” he enlists the help of a well-connected alpha named Kwon Shin-Woo. Together, these reluctant allies will have to uncover the mysteries of the nefarious platform… and each other..

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.native: 初心者女装男子♂を飼ってみた!
title.romaji: Shoshinsha Josou Danshi ♂ wo Katte mita!

title.native: 男の子♂だよ!!～赤ずきん編～
曖昧ブルー・ビースト

193933.description:
Rena, a beautiful young girl with a voluptuous figure, attracts the gaze of every boy. Though she's the object of admiration throughout the school, there are rumors that she's a shameless flirt who'll sleep with anyone. The protagonist doesn't believe the stories... until he catches her engaging in sexual acts at school. The boy is stunned by the revelation. But one day, the Rena he admires so much calls out to him after class...

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Released at Comiket 104.
synonyms: That girl from the upper caste

カースト上位の日常 〜身体の相性抜群の子と必ずヤれる最強のマッチングアプリ

title.romaji: Tachinbo Shiteita Jirai-kei-chan ga Wana ni Kakacchau Ohanashi

title.romaji: Obaka na Ao Oni to Nagasare Aka Oni no Kanabou Taiketsu!?: Rurio to Akane

193937.description:
Atsushi Yanagime, a thirty-eight year old man working for an advertising design company, lives with his wife Ryoko and their four children. He loves his wife, but he's starting to think about divorce. One day, a sign on the window of an old building that said "I want to divorce you" caught his eye. This is the story of a man and a woman swaying between marriage and divorce.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 教えてアゲル♥〜巨乳美人お姉さんと浪人生の僕の○○なお話

title.romaji: Kekkon wo Zentei ni Onaho ni Natte Kudasai

黒狼王子が辺境に押し掛けてきました
title.romaji: Kuro Ookami Ouji ga Henkyou ni Oshikakete Kimashita

193946.description:
A cute romantic comedy about a hot but mysterious new student and a tough-looking guy who is actually a cute bunny on the inside☆

In a world where demihumans―humans born with animal traits―live amongst normal people, Arashi Usami, the biggest delinquent in school, has a huge secret. Despite being big and brawny with looks that could kill, he's actually a rabbit type demihuman.In order to keep his identity concealed, Arashi acts like a lone wolf at school. Then, one day comes the cool and cheerful but mysterious hottie, Shizuka Yamada. For some reason, not only does he seem unafraid of Arashi, he even seems to like him! But, after a while, Arashi notices something strange happening. His body's heating up, and there's only one way to scratch this itch...!!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

193947.description:
Otoha, a 10-year-old girl, is completely depressed after losing her beloved cat Yoruka. One day, in her dream, she meets the "cat god," who is said to be the beloved cat of Kobo Daishi. When Otoha prays to "bring Yoruka back to life," the "cat god" tells her to go and meet his disciples at the temples along the pilgrimage route... the elementary school girl's slightly mysterious pilgrimage journey begins.

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

193948.description:
Once known as a bustling and chaotic city of youth, Shibugaya has become a ghost town ever since man-eating rabbits took up residence underground… But in the face of such danger, wolf girl Izuko, with her bunny-girl friend by her side, arrives on the scene to take on the underground!

(Source: Yen Press)

193949.description:
A man who is mistaken for the lover's live-in boyfriend is the new team leader?!

Chi-Won and Ji-Hyeok first met at a hotel after an uncomfortable incident. While considering each other as 'the person they want to avoid the most' and 'the most interesting person,' they meet by chance at the company. And that too as a direct supervisor and a subordinate!

A cute story of love that ends in a tumultuous battle of dislikes!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: วุ่นชะมัด รักอลเวง
定義されないXX～イケメン上司と秘密の関係～

193950.description:
Seo-Geum is an unemployed shut-in whose only hobby is stalking a singer named Tae-In online and leaving hate comments on his posts. His obsession finally catches up to him when he's sued by Tae-In and forced to meet him at the police station. Instead of feeling remorse, Seo-Geum is instantly smitten when he sees Tae-In's face in real life. Driven by a twisted feeling of "love," he decides to cross the line once again the moment Tae-In steps out of the station. How far will Seo-Geum's dangerous obsession take him this time?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.
synonyms: It's All Your Fault I've Been a Jerk

title.native: 내가 찌질한 건 전부 네 탓이야
title.romaji: Naega Jjijilhan Geon Jeonbu Ne Tasiya

193951.description:
Baek Han-Il, a third-year student in the Department of Business Administration at Korea University. As he lives his life preoccupied with realistic problems, he lacks content to write on his resume. In order to participate in a contest, he creates a club on his own, and when the department's bombshell, Ryu Ji-Oh, joins the club, Han-Il's mind becomes complicated...

"Senior, were you only interested in your body from the beginning? Even in the club and the contest?"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

193952.description:
Grace, the girl Reincarnated into the daughter of a poor Viscount family, inherited nothing but a collapsing land from her father. But with her intelligence and relentless effort, Grace managed to revive this dying territory, becoming a strong leader respected by everyone. Yet despite her success, her heart remained closed to love — especially after a painful betrayal that led to the unfair cancellation of her engagement. One day, while accompanying her younger sister, Jessica, to her debut at a noble’s ball, something completely unexpected happened...

The famous Count, Lord Rockwell — known for his strength and striking good looks — approached her and asked for a dance, saying with a charming smile, "Yes, I am a knight... but what I truly desire is to become your prince." Words Grace had never heard before... And caught between the hesitation of her heart and the warmth of those words, she found herself unconsciously placing her hand in his.

title.native: 転生令嬢は悪名高い子爵家当主 ～領地運営のための契約結婚、承りました～
title.romaji: Tensei Reijou wa Akumyoudakai Shishaku-ke Toushu: Ryouchi Unei no Tame no Keiyaku Kekkon, Uketamawarimashita

193953.description:
When a former detective wakes up as Ordelle Kyris, the villainess and fake saint of the novel "Idella the Holy," she is entrusted with the task of saving the Sun God and this world from disappearing forever. However, being a fake, her divine power is close to nothing. And the only way to increase it is... money! From securing rich followers to starting a new business, Ordelle strives to gather funds and gain more power. Will this fake yet fiery saint successfully climb the ladder of holiness?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Will Buy Divine Power With Money!

193954.description:
"You don't have to worry anymore; I'll take care of you forever..." Imprisoned by the girl next door—!

Going to work every day feeling dead inside and being worked to the bone, one day I mistakenly think a plastic bag caught on a power line is a cat. In a panic, I lean out from the balcony to help, and that's when the girl next door thinks I'm trying to jump and comes to my rescue. When I come to, I find myself tied up in her house...!? "I'm going to protect you. I'll teach you the joy of living." With those words, she straddles me with her voluptuous body. I know I need to escape, but at this rate, I might end up being completely drained by this yandere girl next door...!?

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: Being a Yandere’s Prisoner Is Actually Kind of Nice

title.english: Being a Yandere's Prisoner Is Actually Kind of Nice
title.native: ヤンデレ監禁生活は意外と天国です
title.romaji: Yandere Kankin Seikatsu wa Igaito Tengoku desu

193956.description:
The protagonist, who was raised as an orphan and died without ever knowing the love of a family, is reincarnated as the beloved second son of a noble family—Ares?! His parents adore him, and his older sister and brother are always by his side. Growing up in a household overflowing with love, Ares’ life is a complete 180° from his previous existence.

Then, on an otherwise peaceful day, Ares is discovered to have the ability to use "Ice Magic", which is supposed to be impossible in this world?! Before long, his fate begins to shift dramatically, involving even the entire kingdom!

title.native: 前世で家族に恵まれなかった俺、今世では優しい家族に囲まれる
title.romaji: Zense de Kazoku ni Megumarenakatta Ore, Konse dewa Yasashii Kazoku ni Kakomareru

193957.description:
Marie, a naive girl living a humble life as the daughter of a country nobleman, assisting the peasants, is offered a marriage by her parents-in-law. Her stepfather offers her a marriage proposal, but it is to the "Lord of the Devils," a man who is the subject of many frightening rumors. Marie's relationship with her step-parents is not good, but she is indebted to them for raising her, so she decides to accept the marriage proposal. However, when she visits the Devil Lord's mansion, she finds an unexpected truth awaiting her.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)
synonyms: The Bride and the Devil's Promise

193958.description: Note: Published in Jump GIGA 2019 SUMMER vol.2

193959.description: Note: Published in Jump GIGA 2019 SUMMER vol.2

193960.description:
Ariadne only wished her loving half-brother, Siegbert, to be the emperor...but he betrayed her. But the moment she was executed, she was back in time.

Ariadne found herself as a fifteen-year-old girl, before she even met Siegbert. Now she can redo everything...she must avoid that bad ending!

In order to survive, she decides to ally Arnold, the first prince. She had poisoned him in her first life, but this time he seems to be in love with her.

The brave princess is determined to change her fate...and have her revenge.

(Source: BookWalker)
synonyms: The Resurrected Evil Empress Rewrites Her Dark Past
Kaiki Shita Akugyaku Koujo wa Kokurekishi wo Nurikaeru

title.english: The Resurrected Evil Princess Rewrites Her Dark Past
title.native: 回帰した悪逆皇女は黒歴史を塗り替える
title.romaji: Kaiki Shita Akugyaku Koujo wa Koku Rekishi wo Nurikaeru

193961.description:
In my past life, I struggled through countless part-time jobs, only to suffer a head injury in an unexpected accident. But when I opened my eyes, instead of a hospital ceiling, I see a traditional Eastern-style house? That’s right! I’ve reincarnated into the novel "The Noble Sons of the Namgung Clan," the very book I was reading before I died! Of all places, I woke up in a crazy story where people drop like flies… And worse, I’m a villainous side character who gets abandoned by her family and is the first to die a meaningless death! Fine. With all the experience I gained from my past-life jobs, I’ll escape this house before I meet my doom. Wait, what? Every time I show off my skills, the main characters start falling for me? The cold-hearted older brothers, the vengeful cult leader, even the tragic crown prince—all of them are getting tangled up with me! If the story follows the original plot, everyone is doomed to a bad ending... Alright! If it’s come to this, I’ll save them all. A well-raised side character can save many lives!!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: I'm a Martial Arts Supporting Character, Can You Raise Me?
虐げられる姫に転生したのでなんとか生き残る

193963.description:
Sentai otaku Asahi meets Ushio, who she met on a lesbian-only dating app, at an amusement park. The two are instantly attracted to each other, and begin an escort battle to show off their attraction during their date...!

(Source: Booth.pm)

title.native: デート相手がイケメン♀だった件
title.romaji: Date Aite ga Ikemen ♀ Datta Kudan

193966.description:
At a certain yandere cafe, customers can safely indulge in the fantasy of being the object of dangerously obsessive love. For yandere-obsessed high schooler Kuraki, having a cast of professional yanderes performing terrifying acts of devotion on him is a dream come true! But as the staff begin to fall for Kuraki’s natural charm, their "performances" start to feel a little too real…?!

A comedy about an oblivious yandere-loving boy and the yanderes he unintentionally creates!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Square Enix for serialization .

title.native: ヤンデレカフェへようこそ

193970.description:
Aki, her childhood friend, is a tough-looking guy that scares off other people, but what's he really like…?

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in 2025 Issue 12 of Margaret magazine.

193972.description:
The reclusive consort took only five years to climb up the ranks and become a court official. Leading a double life, the consort dresses as a man to solve all of the many challenges the empire faces! But her true identity behind both masks is a Japanese woman called Saya who had been transported into this Eastern-themed world, where black is considered the color of nobility. Bored of the luxurious and uneventful life of a consort, she dresses up as a man and sneaks out of the harem to work as a court official! She'll have to hide both her hair color and identity while she navigates the royal court and the dangers that threaten the nation.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title.english: The Reclusive Consort of the Rikan Empire: Sneaking Out of the Rear Palace to Be a Court Official
title.native: 璃寛皇国ひきこもり瑞兆妃伝 日々後宮を抜け出し、有能官吏やってます。
title.romaji: Rikan Koukoku Hikikomori Zuichou Hiden: Hibi Koukyuu wo Nukedashi, Yuunou Kanri Yattemasu.

193973.description:
A family runs a popular video channel with 500,000 subscribers. Their daughter Mika, a high school student, has been in poor health since she was a child, and the family is known for coming together to fight against her illness. Ritsuko, in particular, is especially diligent in taking care of Mika, but there is a terrifying intention hidden behind all of this!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

193974.description:
A single mother with a middle school diploma aims to get into Tokyo University to get her life back on track! Kaoru Hayashibara is a 31-year-old single mother who divorced her husband due to his infidelity and is raising her elementary school-aged son Jin alone. In order to get back at her ex-husband, she decides to take the university entrance exam and hires Minami, a student at Tokyo University, as her private tutor. Kaoru aims to get into the top university, Tokyo University!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 次の恋にこたえなさい。
title.romaji: Tsugi no Koi no Kotae Nasai.

193975.description:
A romantic comedy about two mismatched people, with their awkward personalities! Touko, an unsuccessful manga artist, meets Riku, a cheerful, younger boy, at her part-time job. She feels that she and Riku, a bright and handsome boy, live in different worlds, but in fact Riku is also aiming to become a manga artist!

Late nights spent working on manuscripts and going on dates for research. A romantic comedy about two polar opposites who slowly grow closer to each other!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

193976.description:
Aya Umeda is a single mother who lost her husband 15 years ago. She lives with her unemployed, reclusive son and two cats. She just wants to live a comfortable, normal life, but life is not that easy. One day, her son gets a job at a strange company and comes home with a strange invention...!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 正常生活 ノーマルライフ

193977.description:
The girl she thought was her best friend has vanished from school. Suzune is now a middle school student and is excited to own a dog. Her days are the same as ever, but then her best friend Sae goes missing...!?

The daily life, friendship, and growing pains of adolescent girls. A story of friendship between a middle school girl, a dog, and an adult.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

193978.description:
Hazuki, Mucchan, and Mei run a snack bar called Rose Quartz. In exchange for inheriting the bar from their late customer, Hide-san, they are to hand over his inheritance to 57 heirs!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

193979.description:
What will become of the brother and sister who killed their parents 14 years ago to escape the abuse they suffered?!

14 years ago, a young brother and sister killed their parents to escape the repeated abuse they suffered, after their parents became obsessed with religion. After leaving the institution, the older sister Akari worked in a cabaret club and the younger brother Sora worked in a factory to make a living, but the gears of fate began to go awry...!

A dark suspense story depicting the bond and destiny of a sinful brother and sister!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

193980.description:
Cute and a little dark! A heartwarming, sharp-tongued comedy about the cat demon Uta and his three human brothers!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

193982.description: The story is set about 10 years after the events of the original series. The protagonist, Shinichi Kuruma, has been forcibly transformed into a "majuu" (a beast-human hybrid) by his father, Genzou Kuruma, a mad scientist seeking to evolve humanity. Shinichi embarks on a quest for revenge, not only against his father but also against the 13 Apostles, who are other powerful hybrid beings, and a cosmic entity called Tokitenkuu, which threatens the fabric of space and time.

title.native: はっぴー・どーる・でいず

193985.description:
Shimura, a kimono shop worker, has a crush on his boss Nishino, the successor of the kimono shop. He'd given up all hopes of love with the charismatic man when one day, a drunk Nishino embraces him under the guise of, "the replacement for the one you love." His sweet-talking and the sex is so hot it's enough to make him melt, Shimura finds himself entranced…

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Young Heir's Infatuation is Too Much to Bear
title.native: 跡取り若様の溺愛が重すぎてたまりません
title.romaji: Atotori Waka-sama no Dekiai ga Omosugite Tamarimasen

193986.description:
A wide variety of bad luck has long burdened Asahi Suzuma, a bearer of great misfortune. Then one day, a piece of his laundry blown away by the wind is picked up by a gorgeous young man named Elle. Delivering the laundry back to Asahi, Elle informs him that he's being possessed by something wicked... Elle goes on to explain that it's his job to cleanse such things, and takes Asahi in his arms, touching him in unexpected places...! What kind of "cleansing" is this? If anything, it seems like a convenient excuse for Elle to do what he wants, but Asahi can't pull away from his skillful caress. Asahi finds himself melting, as Elle plunges deep, deep into his depths...!!

(Source: CLLENN)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Go Deep Enough to Melt Me
title.native: とろけるまで奥まで突いて

193987.description:
A story of an unexpected encounter between a human and a mermaid.

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

193988.description:
Everyday, Tetsudo is driven by thoughts of wanting to die as he works in a company that overworks people. One day, he meets his college bud Kamitezuna again for a long while after 8 years. With his ill complexion as an excuse, Kamitezuna drags Tetsudo away from the last train and invites him to his house.

Note: Released at Comiket 95.

193989.description:
Cheryl, determined to escape from her boring rural island, works hard every day to earn money. Then one day, she encounters a mermaid-like creature born from a 'stone' she found(?) and hopes that selling the child will make her money... From that day on, for some reason, she keeps having lewd dreams with a man.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Inoe Danpyeonseon (인외 단편선) Collection.

193990.description:
Adrian, a vampire who accidentally bit a witch while trying to suck blood and broke his fangs, ends up living with the witch Hilda, who loves lust, against his will until his fangs fully grow back.

"I'll have to cater to your style of play. I'll use all those disgusting tools to make sure you're taken down."

"I won't let a pervert like you get away with it, even if I die!"

Despite these words, Adrian begins to crave for a more intense... play...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Inoe Danpyeonseon (인외 단편선) Collection.

193991.description:
Nine, who is good at work and has a pretty face, wants to have a passionate romance with an older man. However, all around her are people who introduce her to younger men… One day, Nine, who is burning with the desire to date an older man, falls asleep. A strange doll pops out from behind her and wakes her up! Nine, who sees the doll introducing itself as the queen of succubi, thinks it is a dream and ignores everything the doll says and falls back asleep. The queen, who is angry at Nine’s coldness, gives her the fate of living as a lecherous demon. From then on, a strange fever rises in Nine’s body…!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Inoe Danpyeonseon (인외 단편선) Collection.

193992.description:
Eun-Ha, a college student, is asked by Ho-Deok, whom she has always liked, to help with her graduation thesis. Eun-Ha has a hard time refusing the offer, but Ho-Deok reveals that he is an alien and forcefully gets permission from Eun-Ha. The alien's thesis topic is none other than "Earthlings' sexual pleasure." As the research using tentacles and other things progresses, Eun-ha, who was embarrassed, gradually begins to feel sexual pleasure, and seeing her excited, Ho-Deok begins to feel feelings for a human for the first time... Will Ho-Deok be able to complete his thesis safely?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193993.description:
Yuri, who was returning home after working part-time as a tutor, ends up helping someone who has collapsed on the street and ends up drifting away somewhere. When she comes to, she sees three incubi requesting sex lessons in front of her…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Inoe Danpyeonseon (인외 단편선) Collection.

193994.description:
Flora Dain is a noble young lady who dreams of a fairy tale romance. She meets Ion by chance at a party and finds out that he is not human, but she falls for his appearance, which is her style, and asks him out of the blue. However, Ion tells her to “marry me” and takes her to his mansion. Before she knows it, Ion and her have sex, and while they enjoy it, Ion reminds her of the young dragon she saved in the past…?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193995.description:
“On St. Agnes Day, you can see your husband in your dreams!”

After finishing her internship at an adult goods company, Woo Cheon-Hye is teased by her peers in the sculpture department for not being able to make adult goods and getting fired. Cheon-Hye, who had never seen or touched ‘that thing’, swallows her anger in silence and then comes across a video about ‘St. Agnes Day’. She tries the ‘St. Agnes Day’ ritual with the determination to grab onto a rope. Cheon-Hye, who really does meet a handsome man, becomes completely absorbed in her dreams, and the man who was sweetly kissing her suddenly starts taking off Cheon-Hye’s dress…?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

193996.description:
Shu, a student who failed his college entrance exam, collapses on the way home from cram school when Yushi, a handsome stranger, saves him. Instead of recovering at the bar, Shu ends up drunk… and winds up in Yushi's place! Words of Yushi's gentle demeanor and beautiful features escape Shu's lips to which he replies: "I can't hold myself back if you say such cute things." His long fingers and kisses on Shu's sensitive body makes him melt to the core…! His tender guidance never ends!

A love story between a handsome college student, a doting strategist, and a naïve, aspiring college student who needs to decompress!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

193998.description:
Hikaru Kajikawa, who spent his days aimlessly, suddenly wakes up in a strange forest in another world. However, he possesses no skills or special abilities and is attacked by dangerous monsters. With the help of Almatina, a knight in training, he manages to reach a human village. But Alma and he, both holding rather disreputable jobs, become the target of ridicule from other adventurers. Nevertheless, Hikaru, who has since learned to manipulate his magical powers, evolves alongside Alma in an unorthodox way.
